questions.stem: A security team deploys a badge reader and biometric scanner at the data center entrance so that only authorized staff can enter. Which control category and control type does this BEST describe?
questions.explanation: Badge reader dan biometric scanner adalah kontrol **technical (logical)** karena berbasis teknologi, dan bersifat **preventive** karena menghentikan akses sebelum terjadi. Kontrol physical adalah seperti pagar, kunci mekanis, atau penjaga; deterrent hanya bertujuan menakuti pelaku, bukan menolak akses.

questions.stem: Which of the following is the BEST example of a managerial control?

options.text: An annual risk assessment performed by the security committee
A motion sensor that triggers an alarm after hours
A honeypot placed in the DMZ to attract attackers
A firewall rule that blocks inbound RDP traffic

questions.explanation: Managerial (administrative) control adalah kontrol berbentuk kebijakan, prosedur, standar, dan proses tata kelola seperti risk assessment. Firewall dan honeypot bersifat technical, sedangkan motion sensor bersifat physical.

questions.stem: A company wants to discourage employees from attempting to tailgate into a restricted floor. Management installs highly visible cameras, warning signs, and a guard station at the elevator lobby, even though the door itself is already badge-controlled. Which control type is being added?
questions.explanation: Kamera yang terlihat jelas, papan peringatan, dan pos penjaga dimaksudkan untuk **mencegah niat** pelaku — itu definisi deterrent. Kontrol corrective memulihkan setelah insiden, compensating menggantikan kontrol yang tidak bisa diterapkan, dan detective hanya mendeteksi (misalnya alarm yang tidak terlihat).

questions.stem: A hospital runs a legacy MRI workstation that cannot be patched because the vendor no longer supports the operating system. The security team places the workstation on an isolated VLAN with strict firewall rules and restricts access to a jump host. Which control type is this?
questions.explanation: Karena patch tidak mungkin diterapkan, tim memakai kontrol lain sebagai pengganti — ini **compensating control**. Isolasi jaringan memang bersifat preventive juga, tetapi dalam konteks "menggantikan patch yang tidak tersedia", jawaban yang paling tepat adalah compensating.

questions.stem: After a ransomware incident, the team wipes the affected servers and restores data from the previous night's backup. Which control type did the restore represent?
questions.explanation: Restore dari backup memulihkan sistem ke kondisi normal setelah insiden terjadi, sehingga termasuk **corrective**. Detective hanya menemukan masalah, sedangkan deterrent dan directive bekerja sebelum insiden.

questions.stem: Which control type is represented by a policy that states "employees must lock their screens when leaving their desks"?
questions.explanation: **Directive control** mengarahkan perilaku melalui aturan tertulis, kebijakan, atau instruksi. Kebijakan lock screen tidak memblokir secara teknis, tidak mendeteksi, dan bukan kontrol fisik.

questions.stem: An attacker modifies a wire transfer record in a database. The bank later uses SHA-256 hashes stored alongside each record to prove the data was altered. Which security property is being protected?
questions.explanation: Hashing membuktikan data tidak berubah — itu **integrity**. Confidentiality dijaga dengan enkripsi, availability dengan redundansi, sedangkan non-repudiation membutuhkan bukti identitas seperti digital signature.

questions.stem: Which combination correctly maps the AAA components to their purpose?

options.text: Authentication encrypts traffic, authorization records activity, accounting proves identity
Authentication proves identity, authorization grants access, accounting records activity
Authentication grants access, authorization proves identity, accounting encrypts traffic
Authentication records activity, authorization proves identity, accounting grants access

questions.explanation: **Authentication** = membuktikan siapa Anda; **authorization** = menentukan apa yang boleh Anda lakukan; **accounting** = mencatat apa yang Anda lakukan (log/audit trail). Urutannya selalu identifikasi → autentikasi → otorisasi → akuntansi.

questions.stem: A user signs in with a username, password, and a code from an authenticator app. The system then checks that the user's role permits access to the payroll module. Which two AAA phases are described?
questions.explanation: Password + kode OTP adalah **authentication** (plus identification di awal), dan pemeriksaan role terhadap modul payroll adalah **authorization**. Accounting baru terjadi saat aktivitas pengguna dicatat.

questions.stem: In a zero trust architecture, which component makes the decision about whether a request should be granted?
questions.explanation: Dalam model NIST SP 800-207, **policy engine** mengambil keputusan (allow/deny) berdasarkan kebijakan dan sinyal konteks. **Policy administrator** mengeksekusi keputusan dengan membuat/menghapus sesi, dan **policy enforcement point** menegakkan keputusan pada lalu lintas aktual.

questions.stem: A company divides its internal network into many small zones so that a compromised web server cannot reach the database subnet directly. Each zone enforces its own least-privilege rules. Which zero trust concept is this?
questions.explanation: **Microsegmentation** membagi jaringan menjadi segmen kecil dengan aturan akses spesifik, menghilangkan implicit trust antar sistem. Implicit trust zone justru konsep yang harus dihilangkan dalam zero trust.

questions.stem: A security team places a fake file named `payroll_master.xlsx` on a file server and alerts whenever it is opened. Which technique is being used?
questions.explanation: **Honeytoken** adalah data umpan (file, record, kredensial) yang tidak punya kegunaan sah; siapa pun yang menyentuhnya hampir pasti penyerang atau insider. Honeypot adalah sistem/ host umpan, bukan artefak data.

questions.stem: Which activity BEST describes a gap analysis?

options.text: Testing whether backups can be restored within the RTO
Reviewing firewall rules for unused entries
Comparing the current security posture against a desired framework or standard to identify missing controls
Scanning the network for unpatched hosts

questions.explanation: **Gap analysis** membandingkan kondisi saat ini dengan target (misalnya ISO 27001 atau NIST CSF) lalu mengidentifikasi kekurangan. Opsi lain adalah aktivitas operasional spesifik, bukan analisis kesenjangan menyeluruh.

questions.stem: Before approving a change to the production VPN concentrator, the change advisory board asks: "If the change fails, how do we get back to the previous state within 30 minutes?" Which change management element does this question address?
questions.explanation: **Backout plan** (rollback plan) menjelaskan cara mengembalikan sistem ke kondisi semula bila perubahan gagal. Impact analysis menilai dampak perubahan, maintenance window menentukan jadwal, dan approval adalah persetujuan itu sendiri.

questions.stem: A developer wants to push an emergency patch at 2 p.m. on a Tuesday. The security manager requires a documented approval, a tested result in staging, and notification to all stakeholders before the change is applied. Which process is being enforced?
questions.explanation: Persetujuan, pengujian, komunikasi stakeholder, dan jadwal perubahan adalah elemen **change management**. Tujuannya mencegah perubahan yang tidak terdokumentasi dan memicu gangguan produksi.

questions.stem: A digital signature provides which set of security properties?
questions.explanation: Digital signature mengenkripsi hash pesan dengan private key pengirim, sehingga penerima dapat memverifikasi **integrity**, memastikan identitas pengirim (**authentication**), dan penandatangan tidak bisa menyangkal (**non-repudiation**). Signature tidak menyembunyikan isi pesan, jadi bukan confidentiality.

questions.stem: A company encrypts its backup tapes and stores a copy of the encryption keys with a trusted third party so that data can be recovered if the administrator leaves. Which concept is this?
questions.explanation: **Key escrow** menyimpan salinan kunci pada pihak ketiga tepercaya untuk keperluan pemulihan. Key rotation adalah pergantian kunci berkala, key stretching memperkuat password lemah, dan key exchange adalah pertukaran kunci (misalnya Diffie-Hellman).

questions.stem: Which statement correctly distinguishes a TPM from an HSM?

options.text: A TPM stores certificates only; an HSM stores passwords only
A TPM is a dedicated appliance for high-volume transaction cryptography; an HSM is a chip soldered to a motherboard
A TPM is a chip that stores keys and measurements on a single host; an HSM is a hardened appliance or service that performs cryptographic operations for many systems
Both are software libraries used to generate certificates

questions.explanation: **TPM** adalah chip kriptografi pada satu perangkat (untuk BitLocker, measured boot, attestation). **HSM** adalah perangkat/ layanan khusus yang diperkuat untuk operasi kriptografi bervolume tinggi dan penyimpanan kunci pada level organisasi.

questions.stem: An administrator must verify whether a certificate was revoked without downloading the entire revocation list. Which mechanism should be used?
questions.explanation: **OCSP** (Online Certificate Status Protocol) memungkinkan pemeriksaan status satu sertifikat secara real time tanpa mengunduh seluruh daftar. CRL adalah daftar lengkap yang diunduh, CSR adalah permintaan sertifikat, dan trust anchor adalah root certificate yang dipercaya.

questions.stem: Why is a unique random salt added to each password before hashing?

options.text: To prevent identical passwords from producing identical hashes and to defeat precomputed rainbow tables
To encrypt the password with the server's public key
To allow the password to be reversed by the administrator

questions.explanation: **Salt** memastikan dua pengguna dengan password sama menghasilkan hash berbeda, sehingga rainbow table yang sudah dihitung sebelumnya tidak berguna. Salt bukan enkripsi dan tidak membuat hash bisa dibalik.

questions.stem: Which technique is designed to make brute-force attacks against stored passwords slower by repeatedly applying a hash function?
questions.explanation: **Key stretching** (misalnya PBKDF2, bcrypt, Argon2) menerapkan fungsi hash berulang kali dengan biaya komputasi tinggi sehingga setiap tebakan menjadi lambat. Salting mencegah rainbow table tetapi tidak memperlambat per tebakan.

questions.stem: Which statement about hashing and encryption is CORRECT?

options.text: Hashing requires a shared secret key
Hashing is reversible with the correct key; encryption is not
Hashing is a one-way function used for integrity; encryption is reversible and used for confidentiality

questions.explanation: **Hash** bersifat satu arah (tidak bisa dikembalikan) dan dipakai untuk integritas/verifikasi. **Enkripsi** bersifat reversibel dengan kunci yang tepat dan melindungi kerahasiaan.

questions.stem: A company stores transaction records in a distributed ledger where each block contains the hash of the previous block and is replicated across nodes. Which property does this design primarily provide?
questions.explanation: **Blockchain** mengaitkan setiap blok dengan hash blok sebelumnya sehingga perubahan satu blok merusak seluruh rantai — sifatnya tamper-evident (integritas). Blockchain tidak otomatis menjamin kerahasiaan karena isinya bisa terbaca semua node.

questions.stem: An organization wants full-disk encryption keys to be sealed to the hardware and released only when the boot measurements match a known-good state. Which technology is MOST appropriate?
questions.explanation: **TPM** menyegel kunci ke platform dan melakukan **measured boot**; kunci hanya dilepas bila PCR (measurement) sesuai. HSM melayani banyak sistem, sedangkan secure enclave melindungi kode/data dalam CPU, bukan mengukur boot.

questions.stem: Why do most TLS connections use asymmetric cryptography only during the handshake?

options.text: Because asymmetric algorithms cannot encrypt data
Because symmetric encryption is much faster for bulk data transfer
Because asymmetric keys are always public
Because symmetric keys cannot be rotated

questions.explanation: Kriptografi asimetris dipakai untuk autentikasi dan menyepakati kunci sesi karena mahal secara komputasi; transfer data massal kemudian memakai **symmetric** (AES) yang jauh lebih cepat. Asymmetric tetap bisa mengenkripsi data kecil, hanya tidak efisien.

questions.stem: A stolen laptop is recovered. Investigators find the disk was protected with BitLocker, but a single sensitive file copied to a USB drive was readable. Which encryption scope would have protected that file?
questions.explanation: FDE melindungi data saat disk dalam keadaan mati, tetapi file yang sudah dikopi ke media lain tidak lagi terlindungi. **File-level encryption** (atau container terenkripsi) tetap melekat pada file tersebut di mana pun ia berada.

questions.stem: Which protocol pairing is CORRECT for protecting email contents end to end?

options.text: S/MIME for email, IPsec for network layer
TLS for email storage, SSH for web traffic
DNSSEC for email, SFTP for web traffic
HTTPS for email, SNMPv3 for file transfer

questions.explanation: **S/MIME** memberi enkripsi dan tanda tangan pada pesan email, sedangkan **IPsec** melindungi lalu lintas pada layer network (mode tunnel/transport). TLS melindungi hop transport, bukan isi email end-to-end.

questions.stem: Which technique replaces sensitive data with a non-sensitive placeholder that maps back to the original value in a secure vault?
questions.explanation: **Tokenization** menukar data asli (misalnya nomor kartu kredit) dengan token yang tidak bermakna; pemetaan disimpan di vault. Data masking biasanya mengubah tampilan secara permanen (misalnya `****-****-****-1234`), sedangkan steganografi menyembunyikan data di dalam media lain.

questions.stem: An attacker finds two different documents that produce the same MD5 hash and uses this to replace a legitimate file undetected. Which cryptographic weakness was exploited?
questions.explanation: **Collision** terjadi ketika dua input berbeda menghasilkan hash yang sama; MD5 dan SHA-1 sudah terbukti rentan. Downgrade menurunkan versi protokol, rainbow table menyerang password, dan brute force menebak kunci.

questions.stem: A client and server negotiate TLS, but an on-path attacker forces them to use TLS 1.0 with weak ciphers. Which attack is described?
questions.explanation: **Downgrade attack** memaksa kedua pihak memakai versi protokol atau cipher suite yang lebih lemah agar mudah diserang. Mitigasinya: menonaktifkan protokol lama dan mengaktifkan strict security settings di kedua sisi.

questions.stem: A root certificate authority's private key is compromised. What is the MOST immediate risk?

options.text: All leaf certificates can no longer be encrypted
Attackers can issue trusted certificates for any domain, enabling impersonation

questions.explanation: Dengan private key root CA, penyerang dapat menerbitkan sertifikat yang tampak sah untuk domain apa pun (misalnya bank), sehingga terjadi impersonation dan MITM. Inilah alasan root CA dijaga offline di HSM dan ada mekanisme revocation.

questions.stem: A data center uses two sets of doors with an interlocking mechanism: the first door must close before the second opens, preventing piggybacking. What is this called?
questions.explanation: **Access control vestibule** (mantrap) adalah ruang kecil dengan dua pintu interlock untuk mencegah tailgating/piggybacking. Bollard adalah penghalang kendaraan, Faraday cage memblokir sinyal elektromagnetik.

questions.stem: Which physical control is specifically designed to prevent a vehicle from ramming a building entrance?
questions.explanation: **Bollards** adalah tiang penghalang fisik untuk mencegah kendaraan menabrak bangunan atau area terlarang. Lighting bersifat deterrent/detective, motion sensor detective, proximity reader untuk kontrol akses.

questions.stem: A SOC wants to detect attackers early by exposing a decoy server with fake credentials and monitoring all interaction with it. Which two concepts are combined here?
questions.explanation: Server umpan adalah **honeypot**, sedangkan kredensial palsu di dalamnya adalah **honeytoken**. Kombinasi ini mendeteksi dan mempelajari teknik penyerang tanpa memberi akses ke aset nyata.

questions.stem: A critical zero-day forces administrators to apply an emergency patch outside the normal approval cycle. Which action keeps the change management process intact?

options.text: Apply the patch immediately, then document it and obtain retrospective approval from the change advisory board
Skip documentation because the change is urgent
Wait for the next monthly change window regardless of risk
Let the administrator approve their own change without review

questions.explanation: **Emergency change** tetap harus dicatat dan ditinjau (sering secara retroaktif) oleh CAB. Melewati dokumentasi menghilangkan jejak audit dan membuat rollback sulit; menunggu jadwal normal justru membiarkan risiko aktif.

questions.stem: Which document provides the step-by-step tasks, responsible roles, and verification checks for applying a security patch?
questions.explanation: **SOP** merinci langkah operasional, peran, dan verifikasi sehingga perubahan konsisten dan dapat diaudit. Kebijakan AUP mengatur perilaku pengguna; BIA dan risk register bukan instruksi teknis.

questions.stem: A group has spent two years developing custom malware and has repeatedly targeted government research networks in multiple countries. The group is well funded, patient, and interested in stealing intellectual property rather than money. Which threat actor does this BEST describe?
questions.explanation: Ciri **nation-state/APT**: pendanaan besar, malware kustom, kampanye jangka panjang, dan motif spionase. Hacktivist termotivasi ideologi dan biasanya aksinya lebih terbuka; unskilled attacker memakai tool yang sudah ada; insider berada di dalam organisasi.

questions.stem: An attacker defaces a company website with a political message and leaks internal emails to protest the company's supply contracts. Which motivation BEST explains this behavior?
questions.explanation: Aksi defacement dan kebocoran data untuk menyampaikan pesan politik adalah ciri **hacktivist** yang dimotivasi ideologi. Pencurian data untuk dijual atau spionase tidak sesuai dengan pola ini.

questions.stem: A systems administrator resigns and, during the last week of employment, copies the customer database to a personal cloud drive. Which threat actor category applies?
questions.explanation: **Insider threat** adalah orang dengan akses sah yang menyalahgunakan aksesnya, termasuk karyawan yang akan keluar. Shadow IT lebih mengarah pada penggunaan teknologi tanpa persetujuan, bukan pencurian data dengan niat jahat.

questions.stem: A criminal group operates a ransomware-as-a-service platform, recruits affiliates, and demands payment in cryptocurrency. Which threat actor is described?
questions.explanation: **Organized crime** menjalankan serangan untuk keuntungan finansial dengan struktur bisnis, termasuk model RaaS dan afiliasi. Nation-state fokus pada spionase/geo-politik, hacktivist pada ideologi.

questions.stem: A marketing team signs up for an unsanctioned cloud file-sharing service to collaborate with an agency, bypassing IT review. Which term describes this situation?
questions.explanation: **Shadow IT** adalah penggunaan perangkat, aplikasi, atau layanan TI tanpa persetujuan/pengetahuan departemen TI. Risikonya: data tidak terklasifikasi, tidak terpantau DLP, dan sulit diaudit.

questions.stem: An individual with limited technical skill downloads a ready-made exploit kit and runs it against random IP addresses. Which term BEST describes this actor?
questions.explanation: **Unskilled attacker** (script kiddie) memakai tool siap pakai tanpa memahami mekanismenya, biasanya untuk mencari korban acak. ATP/APT justru memiliki keahlian dan sumber daya tinggi.

questions.stem: Which attribute MOST clearly distinguishes a nation-state actor from organized crime?

options.text: The level of resources, sophistication, and patience in pursuing strategic goals

questions.explanation: Keduanya bisa memakai malware dan menyerang perusahaan. Yang membedakan adalah **sumber daya, sofistikasi, dan kesabaran** (kampanye bertahun-tahun) untuk tujuan strategis seperti spionase.

questions.stem: Which pair correctly matches a threat actor with its PRIMARY motivation?
questions.explanation: **Organized crime** dimotivasi uang (ransomware, penipuan, penjualan data). Hacktivist = ideologi, nation-state = spionase/strategi, insider bisa bermacam-macam (uang, dendam, kelalaian).

questions.stem: Attackers compromise a managed service provider (MSP) and use its remote management tooling to deploy malware to dozens of the MSP's customers at once. Which threat vector is this?
questions.explanation: Serangan lewat **supply chain** memanfaatkan kepercayaan pada vendor/MSP/perangkat lunak pihak ketiga. Satu kompromi di penyedia dapat menyebar ke banyak pelanggan sekaligus.

questions.stem: Users who mistype `examp1e.com` for `example.com` are redirected to a site that harvests credentials. Which technique is this?
questions.explanation: **Typosquatting** mendaftarkan domain yang mirip (salah ketik, karakter mirip) untuk menipu pengguna. Watering hole adalah situs sah yang dikompromikan untuk menyerang kelompok tertentu.

questions.stem: Security researchers learn that a website frequently visited by employees of a defense contractor was compromised to serve exploit code only to visitors from that contractor's IP range. Which attack is this?
questions.explanation: **Watering hole** menyerang situs yang biasa dikunjungi target, lalu menyuntikkan malware khusus untuk kelompok tersebut. Spear phishing tetap berbasis pesan yang dikirim langsung ke korban.

questions.stem: An attacker spoofs the CEO's email address and asks the finance director to urgently wire funds to a new supplier account. Which attack is this?
questions.explanation: **BEC** memalsukan identitas eksekutif/rekan bisnis untuk memicu transfer dana atau perubahan data pembayaran. Whaling adalah phishing yang menyasar eksekutif sebagai korban, bukan memalsukan eksekutif untuk menipu staf.

questions.stem: Customers receive a text message claiming their parcel is held at customs, with a link to a credential-harvesting page. Which vector is used?
questions.explanation: **Smishing** adalah phishing melalui SMS. Vishing melalui panggilan suara, phishing umumnya email, dan pretexting adalah teknik membangun alasan palsu (bisa dipakai di semua kanal).

questions.stem: An attacker calls the help desk, claims to be a new employee locked out of the VPN, and asks the agent to reset the MFA token. Which technique is this?
questions.explanation: Panggilan telepon (vishing) dengan cerita palsu yang meyakinkan (pretexting) untuk melewati prosedur help desk. Mitigasinya: verifikasi identitas melalui kanal terpisah dan prosedur reset MFA yang ketat.

questions.stem: An employee finds a USB drive labeled "Payroll 2025" in the parking lot and plugs it into a workstation. Which threat vector is demonstrated?
questions.explanation: **Removable media** (USB) dapat berisi malware atau melakukan HID attack saat dicolok. Kontrol: disable autorun, endpoint protection, dan kebijakan larangan memakai media tak dikenal.

questions.stem: A database server is reachable from the internet on port 3389 with the default administrator password unchanged. Which two threat vectors are combined?

options.text: Open service port and default credentials

questions.explanation: Port 3389 (RDP) yang terbuka ke internet memperluas attack surface, dan **default credentials** memudahkan akses. Mitigasi: tutup port, gunakan VPN/jump host, dan ganti kredensial default.

questions.stem: A production server still runs an operating system that no longer receives security updates. Which term and risk BEST apply?

options.text: Shadow IT; the system is unsupported by IT
Zero-day; unknown vulnerability with no patch
End-of-life system; known vulnerabilities will never be patched

questions.explanation: **EOL/unsupported system** tidak lagi menerima patch, sehingga kerentanan yang sudah diketahui publik akan tetap terbuka. Zero-day adalah kerentanan yang belum diketahui vendor, berbeda konsep.

questions.stem: An attacker within Bluetooth range connects to an unpaired headset and extracts contact data. Which wireless attack vector is this?
questions.explanation: **Bluesnarfing** adalah pencurian data melalui koneksi Bluetooth, sedangkan bluejacking hanya mengirim pesan tak diminta. Deauthentication dan evil twin adalah serangan Wi-Fi.

questions.stem: An employee downloads an invoice document from a supplier's website and opens it. The document contains a macro that downloads a payload when the user clicks "Enable Content". Which threat vector is this?
questions.explanation: **File-based vector** adalah file berbahaya (dokumen bermakro, installer, arsip) yang dieksekusi pengguna, baik dari unduhan maupun media lepas. **Message-based vector** menekankan kanal pesan seperti email, SMS, atau IM yang membawa tautan/lampiran.

questions.stem: A software vendor's build server is compromised, and the attacker inserts malicious code into a signed update that customers install automatically. Which vector is used?
questions.explanation: Ini adalah serangan **supply chain** melalui penyedia perangkat lunak: pelanggan mempercayai update bertanda tangan dari vendor. Pertahanan: verifikasi hash/tanda tangan, code signing yang aman, dan pemantauan perilaku setelah update.

questions.stem: An attacker sends more input to a program than its fixed-size buffer can hold, overwriting the return address and executing shellcode. Which vulnerability is this?
questions.explanation: **Buffer overflow** menulis melebihi batas memori yang dialokasikan sehingga menimpa area lain, termasuk return address. Mitigasi: input validation, safe languages, ASLR, dan DEP.

questions.stem: A web application checks whether a file exists and then opens it, but an attacker swaps the file with a symbolic link between the two operations. Which vulnerability class is this?
questions.explanation: **Race condition TOCTOU** (time-of-check to time-of-use) terjadi karena keadaan berubah antara pemeriksaan dan penggunaan. Mitigasi: operasi atomik, file locking, dan validasi ulang.

questions.stem: A login form returns the error `You have an error in your SQL syntax near 'OR 1=1'`. Which vulnerability is MOST likely present?
questions.explanation: Pesan error SQL yang membocorkan sintaks menunjukkan input pengguna masuk ke query tanpa parameterisasi — **SQL injection**. Mitigasi utama: prepared statements/parameterized queries dan least privilege pada akun database.

questions.stem: A comment field stores raw HTML, and a submitted `<script>` tag executes in every visitor's browser. Which vulnerability is this?
questions.explanation: **Stored (persistent) XSS** menyimpan payload di server sehingga tereksekusi pada semua pengunjung. Reflected XSS hanya muncul dari parameter yang dipantulkan kembali ke satu korban.

questions.stem: A user logged in to a banking site visits a malicious page that silently submits a fund-transfer request using the user's existing session cookie. Which attack is this?
questions.explanation: **CSRF** memanfaatkan sesi korban yang masih aktif untuk mengirim permintaan yang tidak diinginkan. Mitigasi: anti-CSRF token, SameSite cookie, dan verifikasi origin.

questions.stem: A request for `https://shop.example.com/download?file=../../../../etc/passwd` returns the contents of the system password file. Which vulnerability is exploited?
questions.explanation: **Directory traversal** (path traversal) memakai `../` untuk keluar dari direktori yang diizinkan. Mitigasi: validasi path, gunakan allow list nama file, dan jalankan dengan hak minimal.

questions.stem: Malicious code running inside a guest VM exploits a hypervisor flaw to execute on the host. Which vulnerability is this?
questions.explanation: **VM escape** menembus isolasi hypervisor sehingga penyerang menguasai host dan VM lain. Mitigasi: patch hypervisor, matikan fitur tidak perlu, dan batasi akses manajemen.

questions.stem: An organization has 400 virtual machines but only 180 are documented and patched. Many are unused but still running. Which risk is this?
questions.explanation: **VM sprawl** adalah pertumbuhan VM tak terkendali tanpa inventaris dan patch, sehingga muncul sistem tak terkelola. Solusinya: inventaris otomatis, lifecycle management, dan decommissioning.

questions.stem: A developer stores backups in a cloud bucket and sets it to public-read for convenience. Which vulnerability is this?
questions.explanation: **Misconfiguration** cloud (bucket publik, IAM terlalu longgar, logging mati) adalah penyebab kebocoran data paling umum di cloud. Mitigasi: secure baseline, policy as code, dan pemindaian konfigurasi.

questions.stem: Which statement BEST describes a zero-day vulnerability?

options.text: A vulnerability unknown to the vendor, for which no patch exists
A vulnerability in open-source software only
A vulnerability that has been patched but not yet deployed

questions.explanation: **Zero-day** adalah celah yang belum diketahui pembuat software, sehingga belum ada patch pada saat dieksploitasi. Mitigasi tidak bisa mengandalkan patching, melainkan deteksi perilaku, segmentasi, dan virtual patching.

questions.stem: An Android user enables installation of apps from unknown sources to get a free premium app, which then steals banking credentials. Which two risks are present?
questions.explanation: **Sideloading** (memasang aplikasi dari luar toko resmi) membuka jalan bagi aplikasi berbahaya. **Jailbreaking/rooting** adalah membuka kunci sistem operasi, berbeda dari sekadar sideloading.

questions.stem: A router model has not received firmware updates for four years and has known remotely exploitable flaws. Which vulnerability category applies?
questions.explanation: Perangkat **EOL** dengan firmware usang tidak lagi menerima patch dan sering memiliki kerentanan publik. Mitigasi: ganti perangkat, isolasi VLAN, dan batasi akses manajemen.

questions.stem: An application encrypts credit card numbers with a hard-coded AES key stored in the source repository. Which weakness is this?
questions.explanation: Kunci yang di-hardcode di source code dapat dibaca siapa pun yang memiliki akses repo — ini **improper key storage**. Kunci seharusnya disimpan di KMS/HSM dan dirotasi.

questions.stem: Malicious code is injected into a running process by forcing it to load an attacker-controlled library. Which technique is this?
questions.explanation: **DLL injection** memaksa proses yang sah memuat library berbahaya sehingga kode berjalan dalam konteks proses tersebut dan sulit terdeteksi. Ini sering dipakai malware untuk persistence dan menghindari deteksi.

questions.stem: An old virtual machine is deleted and its disk reallocated to a new tenant, who is able to recover fragments of the previous tenant's data. Which risk applies?
questions.explanation: **Resource reuse** terjadi ketika resource (disk, memori, IP) dialokasikan ulang tanpa sanitasi menyeluruh. Mitigasi: enkripsi disk, secure wipe, dan sanitasi sebelum reuse.

questions.stem: A network switch received from a hardware supplier contains an undocumented cellular modem that beacons out. Which vulnerability category is this?
questions.explanation: **Hardware supply chain** compromise menanam komponen atau backdoor pada perangkat fisik. Mitigasi: vendor vetting, inspeksi perangkat, dan pemantauan lalu lintas keluar.

questions.stem: Users report that files on a shared drive have been renamed with a `.locked` extension and a text file demands cryptocurrency. Which malware type is this?
questions.explanation: **Ransomware** mengenkripsi data dan meminta tebusan. Mitigasi: backup offline teruji, segmentasi, dan deteksi perilaku enkripsi massal.

questions.stem: Malware spreads to every host on a network within minutes without any user interaction, exploiting a single unpatched SMB flaw. Which malware type is this?
questions.explanation: **Worm** menyebar sendiri melalui jaringan tanpa interaksi pengguna. Virus membutuhkan eksekusi pengguna/host, trojan menyamar sebagai program sah, logic bomb menunggu pemicu.

questions.stem: A compromised host shows no signs of malware in Task Manager, yet attackers retain administrative access across reboots. Which malware type is MOST likely?
questions.explanation: **Rootkit** bersembunyi di kernel/firmware dan memanipulasi tampilan sistem sehingga prosesnya tidak terlihat. Deteksinya sering memerlukan boot dari media tepercaya atau pemindaian offline.

questions.stem: A workstation periodically sends keystrokes and clipboard contents to an external IP address. Which malware behavior is this?
questions.explanation: **Keylogger** merekam input pengguna (dan sering clipboard) untuk mencuri kredensial. Indikatornya: koneksi keluar periodik, proses tak dikenal, dan alert EDR pada API hooking keyboard.

questions.stem: A terminated employee's script deletes all HR records when it detects that his account has been disabled. Which malware type is this?
questions.explanation: **Logic bomb** adalah kode yang dieksekusi saat kondisi tertentu terpenuhi (waktu, event, status akun). Pencegahannya: code review, kontrol perubahan, dan pencabutan akses segera saat terminasi.

questions.stem: Multiple internal hosts beacon to the same external IP every 60 seconds using HTTPS, and that IP is a known command-and-control server. Which malware infrastructure is present?
questions.explanation: Pola **beaconing** periodik ke C2 menunjukkan host terinfeksi dan tergabung dalam **botnet**. Tindakan: isolasi host, blokir IOC, dan analisis lateral movement.

questions.stem: A server's CPU usage jumps to 100 percent and the security team finds a process mining cryptocurrency. Which malware category applies?
questions.explanation: **Cryptomalware/cryptojacking** memakai resource korban untuk menambang kripto; indikatornya konsumsi CPU/GPU tinggi, tagihan cloud naik, dan koneksi ke pool mining.

questions.stem: An investigation finds no malicious executable on disk, but a PowerShell process loaded a script directly into memory and established outbound connections. Which malware characteristic is this?
questions.explanation: **Fileless malware** berjalan di memori memakai tool sah (PowerShell, WMI) sehingga tidak ada file untuk dipindai signature. Deteksi mengandalkan EDR, script block logging, dan analisis perilaku.

questions.stem: A wireless survey finds two access points with the same SSID, but one has a stronger signal and a different BSSID near the lobby. Which attack is MOST likely?
questions.explanation: **Evil twin** adalah AP palsu dengan SSID sama untuk menipu klien agar terhubung dan menyerahkan kredensial/lalu lintas. Mitigasi: WPA3-Enterprise, certificate validation, dan wireless IDS.

questions.stem: Wireless clients are repeatedly disconnected and forced to reconnect to an attacker's access point. Which attack is being used?
questions.explanation: **Deauthentication attack** mengirim frame deauth palsu sehingga klien terputus dan mencoba terhubung ulang — sering dikombinasikan dengan evil twin. Mitigasi: 802.11w (PMF) dan WPA3.

questions.stem: An attacker on the same LAN sends forged ARP replies so that traffic destined for the gateway goes through the attacker's machine. Which attack is this?
questions.explanation: **ARP poisoning** memetakan IP gateway ke MAC penyerang sehingga terjadi on-path (MITM) di jaringan lokal. Mitigasi: dynamic ARP inspection, port security, dan segmentasi.

questions.stem: Users typing `www.bank.com` are directed to an attacker's IP address because a compromised DNS record was modified. Which attack is this?
questions.explanation: **DNS poisoning** (cache poisoning) mengubah pemetaan nama domain ke IP penyerang. Mitigasi: DNSSEC, resolver tepercaya, dan pemantauan perubahan record.

questions.stem: An attacker configures a switch port as a trunk and gains access to traffic from multiple VLANs. Which attack is this?
questions.explanation: **VLAN hopping** (double tagging/switch spoofing) melewati isolasi VLAN. Mitigasi: matikan DTP, set port access secara eksplisit, dan gunakan VLAN native yang tidak dipakai.

questions.stem: An attacker floods a switch with thousands of fake MAC addresses until it starts broadcasting all frames to every port. Which attack is this?
questions.explanation: **MAC flooding** membanjiri tabel CAM switch sehingga switch berperilaku seperti hub dan lalu lintas dapat disadap. Mitigasi: port security dengan batas MAC dan monitoring.

questions.stem: A user connects to a hotel Wi-Fi and later discovers the captive portal was operated by an attacker who intercepted all traffic. Which attack occurred?
questions.explanation: **On-path (MITM)** menempatkan penyerang di antara klien dan tujuan. Mitigasi: HTTPS dengan certificate pinning/HSTS, VPN, dan tidak mengabaikan peringatan sertifikat.

questions.stem: An attacker captures a valid authentication token and resends it later to gain access. Which attack is this?
questions.explanation: **Replay attack** menggunakan ulang kredensial/token yang sah. Mitigasi: timestamp, nonce, sequence number, dan token berumur pendek (short-lived).

questions.stem: A web service is overwhelmed by traffic from a large botnet, exhausting bandwidth so that legitimate users cannot connect. Which attack type is this?
questions.explanation: Serangan **volumetric** membanjiri bandwidth (misalnya UDP/ICMP amplification). Application-layer DoS menghabiskan resource aplikasi (misalnya HTTP request mahal), dan SYN flood adalah salah satu teknik DDoS, bukan kategori yang paling tepat di sini.

questions.stem: An attacker tries the password `Spring2025!` against 500 different accounts, staying under the lockout threshold for each account. Which attack is this?
questions.explanation: **Password spraying** mencoba sedikit password umum ke banyak akun untuk menghindari lockout. Credential stuffing memakai pasangan username/password hasil kebocoran; dictionary attack menebak banyak password pada satu akun.

questions.stem: Attackers use a list of username/password pairs leaked from another company to log in to your service, succeeding on accounts where users reused passwords. Which attack is this?
questions.explanation: **Credential stuffing** memanfaatkan kredensial bocor dan kebiasaan reuse password. Mitigasi: cek terhadap breach corpus, MFA, dan passwordless.

questions.stem: An attacker steals a password hash database and uses precomputed tables to recover common passwords quickly. Which attack and mitigation pair is CORRECT?
questions.explanation: Tabel **rainbow** memetakan hash ke password yang sudah dihitung sebelumnya; **salt** unik per pengguna membuat tabel tersebut tidak berguna. MFA dan panjang password tetap penting, tetapi bukan penangkal utama serangan offline ini.

questions.stem: Web server logs show requests containing `' UNION SELECT username, password FROM users--`. Which attack is occurring?
questions.explanation: Pola `UNION SELECT` adalah **SQL injection** untuk mengekstrak data dari tabel lain. Mitigasi: parameterized query, WAF sebagai lapisan tambahan, dan least privilege akun DB.

questions.stem: A user account successfully authenticates from Jakarta and, 20 minutes later, from Frankfurt. Which indicator is this?
questions.explanation: **Impossible travel** menandakan kredensial dipakai dari dua lokasi yang tidak mungkin dijangkau dalam waktu tersebut — indikasi akun dicuri. Perlu verifikasi dan pemeriksaan MFA.

questions.stem: A single user account shows five active VPN sessions from different countries at the same time. Which indicator is present?
questions.explanation: **Concurrent session usage** di luar kebiasaan menandakan kredensial dibagikan atau dicuri. Kebijakan biasanya membatasi jumlah sesi simultan dan memicu verifikasi tambahan.

questions.stem: An account is locked after 40 failed logins in two minutes, followed by a help desk call from someone claiming to be the user. Which attack might this indicate?

options.text: Brute force or targeted lockout, possibly social engineering follow-up

questions.explanation: Lonjakan login gagal menunjukkan **brute force** atau sengaja mengunci akun agar korban menghubungi help desk (untuk menipu reset MFA). Ini juga indikator social engineering lanjutan.

questions.stem: A SIEM alert shows a sudden spike in outbound traffic from a database server to an unknown external IP at 3 a.m., while the server's normal traffic is internal only. Which indicator is this?

options.text: Resource consumption and unusual data flow

questions.explanation: Lonjakan trafik keluar yang tidak wajar dapat menandakan **exfiltration** atau C2. Indikator lain seperti resource consumption (CPU/disk) juga bisa menyertai pencurian data atau cryptomining.

questions.stem: An administrator notices that firewall logs for a specific 30-minute window are absent, although the firewall remained online. Which indicator should be investigated?
questions.explanation: **Missing logs** bisa berarti log dihapus, logging dimatikan, atau penyerang menutupi jejak. Bandingkan dengan sumber log lain (SIEM, syslog server) untuk memastikan.

questions.stem: An organization discovers screenshots of its internal documents posted on a public paste site, along with a claim of stolen data. Which indicator category is this?
questions.explanation: **Published/documented** berarti penyerang mempublikasikan bukti akses atau data curian (leak site, paste site) untuk menekan korban. Ini juga sering menjadi awal negosiasi ransomware.

questions.stem: A legacy manufacturing system cannot be patched. The team places it in its own VLAN with a firewall that permits only one needed protocol to one server. Which mitigation is this?
questions.explanation: **Segmentation** membatasi lalu lintas antar zona; sistem tetap beroperasi tetapi attack surface-nya kecil. **Isolation** biasanya berarti memisahkan sepenuhnya (misalnya air-gap atau VM terisolasi) tanpa konektivitas produksi.

questions.stem: An organization allows only approved executables to run on endpoints; all others are blocked by hash. Which mitigation is this?
questions.explanation: **Allow list** hanya mengizinkan program yang terdaftar (biasanya berdasarkan hash atau sertifikat), sehingga malware baru otomatis diblokir. Block list mudah dilewati karena hanya menolak yang sudah diketahui.

questions.stem: Before a laptop is granted network access, the switch port checks its patch level and antivirus status through an agent. Which technology is this?
questions.explanation: **NAC** (Network Access Control) memeriksa postur perangkat sebelum memberi akses, dan dapat menempatkan perangkat tidak patuh di VLAN remediasi. MDM mengelola perangkat, bukan mengontrol akses jaringan.

questions.stem: A security team wants to detect and automatically respond to malicious behavior such as process injection on endpoints, with the ability to isolate a host. Which tool is MOST appropriate?
questions.explanation: **EDR** mengumpulkan telemetri perilaku, mendeteksi teknik seperti process injection, dan dapat mengisolasi endpoint. HIDS hanya mendeteksi perubahan file/log, antivirus berbasis signature mudah dilewati malware baru.

questions.stem: A company must prevent employees from emailing unencrypted customer ID numbers to personal accounts. Which control is MOST appropriate?
questions.explanation: **DLP** memeriksa konten (pola nomor identitas) dan memblokir/ mengarantina pengiriman ke tujuan tidak sah. FDE melindungi data saat perangkat hilang, bukan saat dikirim keluar.

questions.stem: A suspicious email attachment must be detonated to observe its behavior before release. Which mitigation technique is used?
questions.explanation: **Sandboxing** menjalankan file di lingkungan terisolasi dan memantau perilakunya (network callbacks, file changes). Quarantine hanya menahan pesan, bukan menganalisis perilaku.

questions.stem: A new server is deployed from a hardened image that disables unnecessary services, enforces password rules, and configures logging. Which concept is this?
questions.explanation: **Secure baseline** adalah konfigurasi acuan yang sudah diperkuat dan dipakai untuk semua deployment. Baseline harus diverifikasi berkala (configuration enforcement) agar tidak melenceng.

questions.stem: A server reaches end of life and is removed from the network, its disks are wiped, and its DNS records are deleted. Which mitigation is being performed?
questions.explanation: **Decommissioning** menghapus sistem dari produksi secara aman: cabut akses, sanitasi media, hapus record, dan perbarui inventaris. Ini mengurangi attack surface permanen.

questions.stem: A company must support personal phones for email while enforcing encryption and remote wipe on those devices. Which solution is MOST appropriate?
questions.explanation: **MDM** menerapkan kebijakan perangkat (enkripsi, PIN, remote wipe) dan dapat memisahkan data kerja dari data pribadi pada perangkat **BYOD**. NAC hanya mengontrol akses jaringan.

questions.stem: An administrator wants to block lateral SMB traffic between workstations while allowing it to the file server only. Which control is MOST efficient?
questions.explanation: **Host-based firewall** dapat membatasi lalu lintas per host tanpa mengubah topologi jaringan. Segmentasi jaringan juga bisa, tetapi untuk aturan per-endpoint, host firewall lebih langsung.

questions.stem: Sensitive cryptographic keys must be processed inside a CPU-protected area isolated from the main operating system. Which technology is this?
questions.explanation: **Secure enclave** adalah area terisolasi di dalam prosesor yang melindungi kode dan kunci dari OS utama. TPM adalah chip terpisah untuk menyimpan kunci/measurement, HSM adalah perangkat eksternal.

questions.stem: A company moves its email service to a SaaS provider. Under the shared responsibility model, which task remains the CUSTOMER's responsibility?

options.text: Managing user accounts, access, and data classification

questions.explanation: Pada **SaaS**, penyedia mengelola aplikasi, OS, dan infrastruktur; pelanggan tetap bertanggung jawab atas **identitas, akses, dan data** (termasuk klasifikasi dan berbagi data). Patch aplikasi dan hypervisor menjadi tanggung jawab penyedia.

questions.stem: A team deploys virtual machines in IaaS. Which security task is the CUSTOMER responsible for?

options.text: Physical security of the data center
Patching the guest operating system and configuring security groups

questions.explanation: Pada **IaaS**, pelanggan mengelola OS tamu, patch, konfigurasi keamanan, dan aturan firewall/security group. Lapisan fisik, hypervisor, dan backbone berada pada penyedia.

questions.stem: A development team uses a platform where the provider manages the runtime and OS, while the team only uploads code and configures environment variables. Which service model is this?
questions.explanation: **PaaS** menyediakan runtime dan platform terkelola; tim hanya bertanggung jawab atas aplikasi, konfigurasi, dan data. IaaS menyediakan VM mentah, SaaS menyediakan aplikasi jadi.

questions.stem: A company runs sensitive workloads in its own data center but uses a public cloud for seasonal capacity. Which architecture is this?
questions.explanation: **Hybrid cloud** menggabungkan on-premises dengan cloud publik. Multi-cloud berarti memakai dua atau lebih penyedia cloud publik, sedangkan private cloud sepenuhnya dedicated untuk satu organisasi.

questions.stem: An organization defines its cloud network entirely in Terraform templates stored in Git, and changes are applied through a pipeline. Which concept is this?
questions.explanation: **IaC** memungkinkan infrastruktur didefinisikan dan direview seperti kode, sehingga konsisten dan dapat diaudit. Risikonya: kesalahan konfigurasi menyebar cepat, sehingga pipeline perlu pemeriksaan keamanan (policy as code).

questions.stem: A company runs short-lived functions that execute only when an event occurs, with no server to patch. Which security consideration is MOST important?
questions.explanation: Pada **serverless**, OS dikelola penyedia sehingga risiko bergeser ke **izin fungsi (IAM), secret, dan dependency**. Fungsi dengan izin berlebihan adalah kesalahan umum yang dapat dieksploitasi.

questions.stem: An application is split into small independent services that communicate over APIs and are deployed separately. Which architecture is this?
questions.explanation: **Microservices** memecah aplikasi menjadi layanan kecil dengan API. Keuntungan: isolasi kegagalan dan deployment independen; risikonya: permukaan API luas, autentikasi antar-layanan rumit, dan perlu service mesh/mTLS.

questions.stem: Two containers on the same host are compromised through a kernel vulnerability, allowing the attacker to affect the other container. Which architectural weakness does this illustrate?

options.text: Containers require a hypervisor for isolation

questions.explanation: **Container** berbagi kernel host, sehingga isolasinya lebih lemah daripada VM. Mitigasi: minimal base image, tidak menjalankan sebagai root, seccomp/AppArmor, dan pemisahan host untuk beban kerja sensitif.

questions.stem: A hospital's infusion pumps run an embedded real-time operating system that must respond within milliseconds. Which security constraint is MOST significant?

options.text: The devices do not support Wi-Fi
The devices cannot tolerate standard patching downtime or latency-heavy controls
The devices use outdated web browsers

questions.explanation: Sistem **embedded/RTOS** menuntut determinisme waktu dan ketersediaan tinggi, sehingga patch dan agen keamanan berat sulit diterapkan. Pendekatannya: segmentasi, kontrol jaringan, dan pemantauan pasif.

questions.stem: A power plant uses SCADA to control physical equipment. Which security objective is prioritized above confidentiality in this environment?
questions.explanation: Pada **ICS/SCADA**, gangguan dapat membahayakan nyawa dan peralatan, sehingga **availability dan safety** menjadi prioritas, diikuti integritas. Confidentiality tetap penting, tetapi bukan prioritas utama.

questions.stem: A 5G deployment uses network slicing to give emergency services guaranteed bandwidth separate from consumer traffic. Which security benefit does network slicing provide?

options.text: Automatic encryption of all application data
Elimination of the need for authentication
Isolation between logical networks with distinct policies

questions.explanation: **Network slicing** memisahkan jaringan logis dengan karakteristik dan kebijakan masing-masing, sehingga gangguan atau serangan pada satu slice tidak otomatis meluas. Enkripsi aplikasi tetap diperlukan.

questions.stem: A company wants to centralize routing decisions in a controller while switches forward traffic based on those decisions. Which architecture is described?
questions.explanation: **SDN** memisahkan control plane (controller) dari data plane (switch), sehingga kebijakan dapat diprogram terpusat. Kontroler menjadi aset kritis yang harus diamankan.

questions.stem: A firewall is configured to allow all traffic if its rule engine crashes, to avoid business interruption. Which failure mode is this, and what is the risk?

options.text: Fail-over; traffic goes to a standby device
Fail-closed; traffic is blocked until fixed
Fail-open; all traffic is allowed during failure

questions.explanation: **Fail-open** mengutamakan ketersediaan: saat perangkat gagal, semua lalu lintas diizinkan sehingga kebijakan keamanan hilang. **Fail-closed** lebih aman tetapi berisiko memutus layanan.

questions.stem: An IDS is connected to a mirrored switch port and only receives copies of traffic, so it cannot block an attack. Which deployment characteristic is this?
questions.explanation: IDS biasanya **passive** (menerima salinan trafik dari TAP/SPAN) dan hanya memberi alert. IPS ditempatkan **inline** sehingga dapat memblokir paket secara real time.

questions.stem: A security team must inspect encrypted HTTPS traffic for data leaks. Which capability is required?

options.text: TLS inspection with a trusted internal CA

questions.explanation: **TLS inspection** melakukan dekripsi, inspeksi, lalu enkripsi ulang; perangkat klien harus mempercayai CA internal yang dipakai untuk menandatangani ulang. Ini menimbulkan isu privasi dan harus dikecualikan untuk kategori tertentu (misalnya perbankan).

questions.stem: Which device provides application-layer protection against SQL injection and cross-site scripting for a public web application?
questions.explanation: **WAF** (Web Application Firewall) memeriksa payload HTTP dan dapat memblokir pola serangan aplikasi. Firewall layer 4 hanya melihat IP/port, load balancer membagi trafik, ACL router memfilter alamat/port.

questions.stem: A company replaces separate firewall, IPS, and antivirus gateway appliances with a single device that combines these functions. Which term BEST describes it?
questions.explanation: **UTM** (Unified Threat Management) menggabungkan beberapa fungsi keamanan dalam satu perangkat. Kelemahannya: satu titik kegagalan dan potensi penurunan performa saat semua fitur aktif.

questions.stem: Remote workers must access internal applications without exposing them directly to the internet, and access should be granted per application after device and identity checks. Which solution is BEST?
questions.explanation: **ZTNA** memberikan akses per aplikasi berdasarkan identitas dan postur perangkat, tanpa mengekspos jaringan internal. VPN klasik memberi akses jaringan luas (network-level) setelah terhubung.

questions.stem: An organization wants to connect two branch offices over the internet with encrypted traffic at the network layer, supporting multiple protocols. Which technology is MOST appropriate?
questions.explanation: **IPsec** melindungi lalu lintas pada layer network dan mendukung banyak protokol dalam satu tunnel (mode tunnel untuk site-to-site). TLS hanya melindungi aplikasi tertentu, SSH untuk sesi administratif.

questions.stem: A cloud-first company wants to combine network and security functions (SWG, CASB, firewall, ZTNA) delivered as a service at the edge. Which architecture is this?
questions.explanation: **SASE** menggabungkan SD-WAN dengan layanan keamanan cloud (secure web gateway, CASB, ZTNA, firewall-as-a-service). SD-WAN hanya mengoptimalkan konektivitas WAN.

questions.stem: Administrators must manage servers without exposing SSH to the internet. Which architecture is MOST appropriate?

options.text: Public RDP with IP allow list
Jump host/bastion in a management subnet with MFA

questions.explanation: **Jump host/bastion** terpusat di subnet manajemen, dengan MFA, logging, dan akses terbatas. Ini mengurangi attack surface dibandingkan mengekspos SSH/RDP langsung.

questions.stem: A security architect must place a public web server so that it can be reached from the internet but cannot initiate connections to the internal database subnet. Which design is BEST?

options.text: Put the web server on the internal LAN with a host firewall
Put the database in the DMZ with the web server
Use NAT to hide the web server
Put the web server in a DMZ with rules allowing only required outbound flows

questions.explanation: **DMZ** memisahkan sistem yang dapat diakses publik dari jaringan internal, dengan aturan ketat untuk koneksi keluar. Menempatkan database di DMZ justru meningkatkan risiko.

questions.stem: An organization needs to monitor all traffic between two internal segments without affecting latency or risking a single point of failure. Which deployment is MOST appropriate?
questions.explanation: **TAP/passive sensor** menyalin trafik tanpa berada di jalur data, sehingga tidak menambah latensi atau titik kegagalan. Konsekuensinya, sensor tidak dapat memblokir trafik.

questions.stem: Which statement about agent-based versus agentless security monitoring is CORRECT?

options.text: Agentless requires kernel drivers on every host
Agent-based collects detailed host telemetry but requires software on each endpoint; agentless relies on network or API data
Agentless provides better endpoint process visibility than agent-based

questions.explanation: **Agent-based** memberi visibilitas mendalam (proses, file, registry) tetapi perlu dipasang dan dirawat di setiap host. **Agentless** memakai data jaringan/API, lebih mudah diterapkan tetapi kurang detail.

questions.stem: Which data classification label typically requires the HIGHEST level of protection?
questions.explanation: Dalam skema umum SY0-701, urutan dari paling sensitif: **extremely sensitive > sensitive > confidential > private > public**. Extremely sensitive mencakup data yang kebocorannya dapat menyebabkan kerugian besar (misalnya rahasia dagang inti).

questions.stem: A company must ensure that customer data stored in a cloud region in Germany does not leave the EU. Which concept applies?
questions.explanation: **Data sovereignty** mengharuskan data tunduk pada hukum negara tempat data berada, sehingga lokasi penyimpanan dan replikasi harus dibatasi. Ini memengaruhi pilihan region cloud dan penyedia.

questions.stem: A support portal shows only the last four digits of a customer's card number. Which technique is this?
questions.explanation: **Data masking** menyamarkan sebagian data sehingga tetap terlihat formatnya tetapi tidak dapat dipakai. Tokenization mengganti seluruh nilai dengan token yang dipetakan di vault.

questions.stem: A payment processor replaces card numbers with random tokens, keeping the mapping in a secure vault. Which benefit is PRIMARY?

options.text: The token has no value if stolen, reducing PCI scope
The token can be reversed by anyone
The token shortens the card number for storage
The token encrypts the entire database

questions.explanation: **Tokenization** membuat data curian tidak berguna tanpa akses ke vault, dan dapat mengurangi cakupan kepatuhan (PCI DSS). Token memang dapat dipetakan kembali, tetapi hanya oleh sistem berwenang.

questions.stem: A research dataset must remain usable for analytics but cannot identify individuals even if combined with other datasets. Which technique is MOST appropriate?
questions.explanation: **Anonymization** menghapus atau menggeneralisasi identitas sehingga data tidak dapat dikaitkan kembali ke individu. Enkripsi dan tokenization masih memungkinkan re-identifikasi bila kunci/vault tersedia.

questions.stem: A company keeps customer records indefinitely "just in case". Which policy gap is MOST significant?

options.text: No data retention and destruction policy

questions.explanation: Tanpa **retention policy**, data lama menumpuk dan memperbesar dampak kebocoran serta melanggar kewajiban regulasi. Retention harus menentukan berapa lama disimpan dan bagaimana dihancurkan.

questions.stem: Which method is BEST for destroying data on a failed SSD before disposal?
questions.explanation: SSD memakai wear leveling sehingga overwrite tidak menjangkau semua sel; **physical destruction** atau **crypto-erase** (jika terenkripsi) adalah pilihan aman. Format cepat dan hapus partisi tidak menghilangkan data.

questions.stem: A company wants to prevent sensitive files from being uploaded to personal cloud storage while allowing approved services. Which control is MOST appropriate?
questions.explanation: **CASB** memberikan visibilitas dan kontrol atas penggunaan cloud (shadow IT), termasuk blokir unggahan ke layanan tidak disetujui. NAC mengontrol akses jaringan perangkat, bukan isi unggahan.

questions.stem: Which data state is protected by TLS while data moves between a browser and a web server?

options.text: Data at rest and in use

questions.explanation: **Data in transit** (in motion) dilindungi oleh TLS/IPsec. Data at rest dilindungi enkripsi disk/database, dan data in use dilindungi secure enclave/confidential computing.

questions.stem: A company collects only the customer's email address for a newsletter, even though it could collect birth date and phone number. Which principle is applied?
questions.explanation: **Data minimization** mengumpulkan hanya data yang benar-benar diperlukan untuk tujuan tertentu, mengurangi risiko dan kewajiban kepatuhan.

questions.stem: A system must tolerate the failure of one entire data center with no data loss and near-zero downtime. Which solution is MOST appropriate?

options.text: Active-active clustering across geographically dispersed sites

questions.explanation: **Active-active** di dua lokasi menjalankan beban kerja bersamaan sehingga kegagalan satu site tidak menghentikan layanan dan data direplikasi sinkron. Warm site masih butuh waktu pemulihan; RAID hanya melindungi kegagalan disk.

questions.stem: Which metric represents the maximum acceptable amount of data loss measured in time?
questions.explanation: **RPO** (Recovery Point Objective) menentukan berapa lama data boleh hilang — menentukan frekuensi backup/replikasi. **RTO** adalah waktu maksimal pemulihan layanan, MTTR waktu perbaikan rata-rata, MTBF waktu antar-kegagalan.

questions.stem: A company requires a recovery site that is fully equipped with hardware and data replicated continuously, ready to take over within minutes. Which site type is this?
questions.explanation: **Hot site** memiliki infrastruktur lengkap dan data terbaru sehingga dapat mengambil alih hampir seketika. Warm site punya sebagian infrastruktur, cold site hanya ruang dan daya.

questions.stem: A team runs an exercise where participants discuss their response to a simulated ransomware scenario without actually invoking systems. Which test is this?
questions.explanation: **Tabletop exercise** adalah diskusi skenario untuk menguji prosedur, peran, dan komunikasi tanpa mengubah sistem. Failover test benar-benar memindahkan beban kerja, parallel processing menjalankan site sekunder bersamaan.

questions.stem: Which backup strategy follows the 3-2-1 rule?

options.text: Three backups per day, two servers, one cloud
Three administrators, two approvals, one change window
Three sites, two ISPs, one firewall
Three copies, on two different media, with one copy offsite

questions.explanation: **3-2-1**: tiga salinan data, pada dua jenis media berbeda, dengan satu salinan di lokasi terpisah. Tujuannya melindungi dari kegagalan perangkat, bencana, dan ransomware yang menyebar.

questions.stem: A company wants to avoid dependence on a single cloud provider's availability zone or proprietary services. Which strategies apply?
questions.explanation: **Geographic dispersion** menyebar beban ke beberapa lokasi, dan **platform diversity/multi-cloud** mengurangi risiko kegagalan atau lock-in satu penyedia. Keduanya meningkatkan ketahanan.

questions.stem: A UPS provides 15 minutes of runtime, and a generator starts automatically after 10 seconds. Which risk remains if the generator fails to start?

options.text: Extended outage once the UPS battery is depleted
Data corruption from too much power

questions.explanation: UPS hanya jembatan sementara; jika generator gagal, sistem akan mati setelah baterai habis. Karena itu generator harus diuji berkala dan bahan bakar dipantau.

questions.stem: A load balancer distributes traffic to three web servers, but session data is stored locally on each server, causing users to be logged out randomly. Which solution is MOST appropriate?

options.text: Enable RAID on the load balancer
Sticky sessions or shared session store

questions.explanation: Tanpa **sticky sessions** atau penyimpanan sesi terpusat, pengguna berpindah server dan kehilangan sesi. Solusi umum: session store bersama (Redis) atau cookie berbasis token.

questions.stem: A company must ensure a database can be restored to any point in time within the last 24 hours after accidental deletion. Which capability is required?
questions.explanation: **Point-in-time recovery** memakai backup penuh + log transaksi berkelanjutan sehingga database dapat dipulihkan ke detik tertentu. Backup mingguan saja tidak memenuhi kebutuhan 24 jam.

questions.stem: A system has an MTBF of 2,000 hours and an MTTR of 4 hours. What is its approximate availability?
questions.explanation: Availability = MTBF / (MTBF + MTTR) = 2000 / 2004 ≈ **99.8%**. Ini setara downtime sekitar 1,75 jam per tahun.

questions.stem: During a failover test, the team switches traffic to the secondary site while keeping the primary running, then compares results. Which test type is this?
questions.explanation: **Parallel processing** menjalankan sistem primer dan sekunder bersamaan untuk memvalidasi hasil sebelum beralih penuh. Ini lebih aman daripada failover penuh karena primer tetap tersedia.

questions.stem: A company stores backups on the same SAN as production to simplify recovery. Which principle is violated?
questions.explanation: Backup pada sistem yang sama rentan ikut terhapus saat ransomware atau kegagalan storage. Prinsip **3-2-1** membutuhkan salinan di media dan lokasi berbeda, idealnya satu offline/immutable.

questions.stem: An organization wants to reduce the attack surface of its public API by exposing only required endpoints and validating input at the gateway. Which architecture is MOST appropriate?

options.text: API gateway with schema validation, rate limiting, and authentication

questions.explanation: **API gateway** memusatkan autentikasi, validasi skema, rate limiting, dan logging, sehingga service internal tidak terekspos langsung. Ini juga memudahkan inventaris endpoint.

questions.stem: A network architect needs to enforce that only domain-joined, patched devices can reach the finance VLAN, regardless of user credentials. Which combination is MOST appropriate?

options.text: 802.1X with NAC posture assessment and VLAN assignment

questions.explanation: **802.1X + NAC** memeriksa identitas perangkat dan postur (domain join, patch) sebelum menempatkannya di VLAN yang tepat. MAC allow list mudah dipalsukan dan tidak memeriksa postur.

questions.stem: A new Linux server is deployed with only the required packages, SSH key-only authentication, and a host firewall. Which activity does this describe?
questions.explanation: **Hardening** mengurangi attack surface dengan menonaktifkan layanan tidak perlu, menghapus akun default, dan menerapkan konfigurasi aman. Patching hanya menutup kerentanan yang sudah diketahui.

questions.stem: A wireless network must authenticate each user individually and support certificate-based authentication without a shared key. Which configuration is BEST?
questions.explanation: **WPA3-Enterprise + 802.1X** memberi autentikasi per pengguna dan mendukung EAP-TLS berbasis sertifikat. PSK memakai kunci bersama yang dapat dibagikan; WEP sudah usang dan mudah dipecahkan.

questions.stem: A company issues smartphones to field staff and requires full device encryption, a PIN, and remote wipe, while separating corporate data from personal data. Which solution is MOST appropriate?
questions.explanation: **MDM** menerapkan kebijakan perangkat dan dapat memisahkan data kerja (container/MAM) dari data pribadi. Ini penting pada model **BYOD/COPE**.

questions.stem: Which risk is created by allowing users to sideload applications on corporate mobile devices?

options.text: Apps from untrusted sources may contain malware and bypass store review
The device cannot connect to Wi-Fi

questions.explanation: **Sideloading** melewati kurasi toko aplikasi sehingga malware, spyware, atau aplikasi berbahaya bisa terpasang. Kebijakan MDM biasanya memblokir sumber tidak dikenal.

questions.stem: A company wants to let contractors use their own laptops but requires that corporate applications run in an isolated environment. Which approach is BEST?

options.text: Full disk encryption on personal laptops

questions.explanation: **VDI/application virtualization** menjalankan aplikasi dan data di lingkungan terkontrol, sehingga perangkat pribadi tidak menyimpan data perusahaan. FDE pada perangkat pribadi sulit ditegakkan.

questions.stem: Which action BEST reduces the attack surface of a web server?

options.text: Disable unused modules and services, remove sample applications

questions.explanation: Menonaktifkan modul/layanan tidak terpakai dan menghapus aplikasi contoh menghilangkan jalur serangan yang tidak perlu. Menambah resource tidak mengurangi attack surface.

questions.stem: A workstation is configured to block execution of any binary not signed by the company's certificate authority. Which control is this?
questions.explanation: **Allow listing** hanya mengizinkan binary bertanda tangan/terdaftar, sehingga malware tanpa signature tidak dapat berjalan. Ini termasuk teknik hardening endpoint.

questions.stem: A company must ensure that a decommissioned laptop's drive cannot be read even if the platters are removed. Which method is BEST?

options.text: Moving files to the recycle bin

questions.explanation: **Physical destruction** menjamin data tidak dapat dipulihkan, bahkan dari komponen disk. Quick format dan penghapusan file hanya menghapus referensi, bukan data.

questions.stem: A security team cannot determine which servers are missing patches because there is no authoritative list of deployed systems. Which process is missing?
questions.explanation: **Asset management** mencakup inventaris, penemuan (discovery/enumeration), dan pelacakan kepemilikan. Tanpa itu, pemindaian dan patching tidak lengkap karena aset tak dikenal (shadow assets) terlewat.

questions.stem: Which document BEST tracks who is responsible for a laptop throughout its lifecycle?
questions.explanation: **Asset tag dan catatan penugasan** menghubungkan perangkat dengan pemilik/pengguna, lokasi, dan status. Ini penting untuk audit, pemulihan, dan investigasi.

questions.stem: Before disposing of a multifunction printer, which step is MOST important?

options.text: Sanitize or destroy the internal storage that may contain scanned documents

questions.explanation: Perangkat multifungsi menyimpan gambar dokumen di disk internal; **sanitasi/destruksi** media tersebut mencegah kebocoran data. Mengganti password tidak menghapus data lama.

questions.stem: Which term describes verifying that a storage device has been properly sanitized before reuse or disposal?
questions.explanation: **Certification** (sertifikat sanitasi/destruksi) mendokumentasikan metode dan hasil sehingga organisasi dapat membuktikan kepatuhan. Chain of custody berkaitan dengan bukti forensik.

questions.stem: A vulnerability scan reports a critical flaw on a server, but the security analyst confirms the affected service is disabled. What should the analyst do?

options.text: Mark it as a false positive with justification and evidence
Patch the server immediately during business hours
Ignore all future scans from that scanner
Escalate it as an active incident

questions.explanation: Temuan yang tidak dapat dieksploitasi karena layanan nonaktif adalah **false positive**; dokumentasikan bukti dan tutup dengan justifikasi. Ini berbeda dari false negative (kerentanan nyata yang tidak terdeteksi).

questions.stem: Which CVSS metric group reflects the characteristics of the vulnerability that change over time, such as exploit maturity?
questions.explanation: **Temporal** mempertimbangkan faktor yang berubah seiring waktu (exploit code availability, remediation level). **Base** adalah sifat intrinsik, **environmental** disesuaikan dengan konteks organisasi.

questions.stem: A scanner reports 400 vulnerabilities, but only 12 affect internet-facing systems with known exploits. Which approach BEST prioritizes remediation?

options.text: Fix in CVSS score order regardless of exposure
Prioritize by exploitability, exposure, and business impact

questions.explanation: Prioritas risiko mempertimbangkan **eksposur, exploitability, dan dampak bisnis**, bukan hanya skor mentah. Ini juga alasan CVSS environmental score dan threat intelligence dipakai.

questions.stem: A critical vulnerability cannot be patched for 60 days due to vendor constraints. Which response is MOST appropriate?

options.text: Hide the finding from the report
Immediately decommission the system without a plan
Request a documented exception with compensating controls and review date

questions.explanation: **Exception** yang terdokumentasi dengan kontrol kompensasi (segmentasi, WAF rule, monitoring) dan tanggal review adalah praktik yang benar. Menyembunyikan temuan melanggar tata kelola.

questions.stem: After applying a patch, which activity BEST validates that the vulnerability is actually remediated?

options.text: Rescan the host and verify the finding no longer appears
Ask the vendor whether the patch works

questions.explanation: **Rescan/validation** membuktikan perbaikan berhasil dan tidak ada regresi. Verifikasi juga dapat memakai audit konfigurasi atau uji eksploitasi terkontrol.

questions.stem: A researcher discovers a vulnerability and privately notifies the vendor, agreeing to withhold details until a patch is released. Which practice is this?
questions.explanation: **Responsible disclosure** memberi vendor waktu memperbaiki sebelum detail dipublikasikan. Bug bounty adalah program berhadiah, pen test adalah pengujian terkontrak, threat hunting mencari ancaman aktif.

questions.stem: A penetration test is authorized in writing with defined scope, time window, and emergency contacts. Which document governs this?
questions.explanation: **Rules of engagement** menetapkan ruang lingkup, batasan, jadwal, dan kontak darurat pen test sehingga pengujian legal dan aman. SLA mengatur tingkat layanan, bukan aktivitas pengujian.

questions.stem: Which scan configuration is MOST likely to find missing patches and insecure settings on a server?
questions.explanation: **Credentialed scan** masuk ke sistem dan memeriksa patch serta konfigurasi secara akurat. Unauthenticated scan hanya melihat dari luar dan lebih banyak false positive/negative.

questions.stem: A company wants to continuously identify vulnerabilities in container images before deployment. Which practice is BEST?

options.text: Rely on the base image being official
Disable the registry scanner to speed builds
Scan images in the CI/CD pipeline and block builds with critical findings

questions.explanation: **Shift-left**: memindai image saat build/pipeline sehingga kerentanan tidak pernah mencapai produksi. Pemindaian tahunan terlalu lambat untuk lingkungan yang sering berubah.

questions.stem: Which tool aggregates logs from firewalls, servers, and applications, correlates events, and generates alerts?
questions.explanation: **SIEM** mengumpulkan, menormalkan, dan mengorelasikan log untuk deteksi serta investigasi. NetFlow hanya metadata trafik, WAF melindungi aplikasi web, NAC mengontrol akses perangkat.

questions.stem: An analyst wants to automatically enrich alerts, create tickets, and block an IP without manual steps. Which technology is MOST appropriate?
questions.explanation: **SOAR** mengotomatiskan playbook respons: enrichment, ticketing, dan tindakan seperti blokir IP. SIEM berfokus pada pengumpulan dan korelasi, bukan orkestrasi tindakan.

questions.stem: A network engineer needs summary metadata about which hosts communicate most, without capturing full packet contents. Which technology is BEST?
questions.explanation: **NetFlow** memberi metadata aliran (source/destination, port, byte count) dengan overhead rendah. Packet capture menyimpan isi paket dan jauh lebih besar.

questions.stem: An alert fires for the same benign administrative script every morning, drowning out real alerts. Which action is MOST appropriate?

options.text: Tune the alert with an exception for that known-good behavior
Ignore all alerts from that host
Increase the alert threshold for every rule

questions.explanation: **Alert tuning** mengurangi false positive dengan mengecualikan perilaku yang diketahui aman, tanpa mematikan deteksi lain. Mengabaikan seluruh host berisiko melewatkan serangan nyata.

questions.stem: Which data source is BEST for identifying a malicious process that ran only in memory on an endpoint?
questions.explanation: **EDR** merekam eksekusi proses, command line, dan interaksi API sehingga aktivitas fileless dapat terlihat. Firewall/NetFlow hanya menunjukkan koneksi jaringan.

questions.stem: A SOC wants to detect compromised hosts by analyzing DNS queries for domains associated with malware. Which tool is MOST appropriate?

options.text: DNS filtering with threat intelligence feeds

questions.explanation: **DNS filtering/threat intel** dapat memblokir atau menandai resolusi ke domain jahat (C2, phishing). Ini juga membantu menemukan host yang terinfeksi meski trafiknya terenkripsi.

questions.stem: Which protocol should be used to collect device status and traps securely from network equipment?
questions.explanation: **SNMPv3** mendukung autentikasi dan enkripsi, sedangkan v1/v2c mengirim community string dalam plaintext. Telnet dan TFTP juga tidak terenkripsi.

questions.stem: A file integrity monitoring tool alerts that `/etc/passwd` changed outside the change window. Which type of monitoring is this?
questions.explanation: **FIM** memantau perubahan file kritis dengan hash dan memberi alert saat ada modifikasi tak terduga — indikasi persistence atau backdoor.

questions.stem: A company wants to prevent users from visiting known phishing and malware domains at the DNS level. Which control is MOST appropriate?
questions.explanation: **DNS filtering** memblokir resolusi domain berbahaya untuk seluruh jaringan, termasuk perangkat yang tidak bisa dipasangi agen. Ini lapisan pertahanan tambahan, bukan pengganti endpoint protection.

questions.stem: An organization wants to ensure that only authenticated and encrypted LDAP queries are allowed. Which configuration is required?
questions.explanation: **LDAPS** membungkus LDAP dalam TLS (port 636) sehingga kredensial dan query tidak dikirim plaintext. LDAP 389 tanpa StartTLS rentan disadap.

questions.stem: Which email authentication mechanism allows a domain owner to specify which servers may send email on its behalf?
questions.explanation: **SPF** mendaftarkan IP/server yang diizinkan mengirim email untuk domain. **DKIM** menandatangani pesan, **DMARC** memberi kebijakan berdasarkan hasil SPF/DKIM dan laporan.

questions.stem: A company wants to receive reports about emails that fail authentication and instruct receivers to reject them. Which record provides this?

options.text: DMARC record with p=reject and rua reporting

questions.explanation: **DMARC** dengan `p=reject` memerintahkan penolakan pesan yang gagal alignment, dan `rua` mengirim laporan agregat. SPF saja tidak memberi kebijakan penanganan atau laporan.

questions.stem: Which secure protocol should replace Telnet for remote administration of network devices?
questions.explanation: **SSH** menyediakan sesi administratif terenkripsi dan terautentikasi. FTP, HTTP, dan SNMPv1 mengirim data (termasuk kredensial) tanpa enkripsi.

questions.stem: A SOC wants to detect anomalous user behavior such as accessing unusual volumes of data at odd hours. Which technology is MOST appropriate?
questions.explanation: **UEBA** (User and Entity Behavior Analytics) membangun baseline perilaku dan menandai anomali seperti akses data masif atau login di luar kebiasaan — berguna untuk insider threat.

questions.stem: To reduce the risk of credential theft from memory, which Windows protection should be enabled?
