questions.explanation: **Credential Guard** mengisolasi secret (NTLM hash, Kerberos TGT) dari LSASS sehingga sulit diambil dengan Mimikatz. AutoPlay dan SMBv1 justru meningkatkan risiko.

questions.stem: Which capability allows an organization to block USB mass storage on endpoints while still permitting keyboards and mice?
questions.explanation: **Device control** (bagian dari endpoint protection/Group Policy) dapat membedakan kelas perangkat dan memblokir storage massal tanpa mematikan HID. Ini mengurangi risiko exfiltration dan infeksi via USB.

questions.stem: An employee left the company three weeks ago, but her account still authenticates and has access to email. Which IAM process failed?
questions.explanation: **Deprovisioning** harus menonaktifkan/menghapus akun, mencabut token, dan memindahkan data segera saat karyawan keluar. Akun yatim (orphaned account) adalah temuan audit yang serius.

questions.stem: After signing in once to a corporate identity provider, a user can access email, CRM, and the intranet without re-entering credentials. Which capability is this?
questions.explanation: **SSO** memungkinkan satu autentikasi untuk banyak aplikasi melalui trust ke IdP. Risikonya: satu kredensial yang dicuri membuka banyak aplikasi, sehingga MFA dan Conditional Access wajib.

questions.stem: Which statement correctly distinguishes SAML from OAuth?

options.text: OAuth authenticates users directly; SAML authorizes APIs
SAML is an authentication/authorization federation standard using XML assertions; OAuth is an authorization framework for delegated access using tokens
SAML is used for API authorization; OAuth is used for browser SSO only

questions.explanation: **SAML** mengirim assertion XML tentang identitas dan atribut untuk SSO enterprise. **OAuth 2.0** mendelegasikan akses (misalnya aplikasi pihak ketiga ke API) memakai access token; autentikasi di atas OAuth dilakukan oleh **OIDC**.

questions.stem: A user authenticates to Active Directory and receives a ticket-granting ticket used to request service tickets. Which protocol is this?
questions.explanation: **Kerberos** memakai KDC, TGT, dan service ticket untuk autentikasi mutual dalam domain. RADIUS/TACACS+ untuk AAA jaringan, LDAP untuk query direktori.

questions.stem: Which statement about RADIUS and TACACS+ is CORRECT?

options.text: RADIUS encrypts the entire packet; TACACS+ encrypts only the password
Both use UDP and encrypt nothing
TACACS+ is only for wireless authentication
RADIUS typically uses UDP and encrypts only the password; TACACS+ uses TCP and encrypts the entire payload

questions.explanation: **RADIUS** (UDP 1812/1813) umum untuk AAA jaringan dan mengenkripsi password saja; **TACACS+** (TCP 49) memisahkan authentication, authorization, accounting dan mengenkripsi seluruh body — sering dipakai untuk admin perangkat.

questions.stem: An application must query user attributes and group membership from Active Directory over a standard protocol. Which protocol is used?
questions.explanation: **LDAP** adalah protokol direktori untuk membaca/mengubah objek seperti user dan group. Aksesnya harus melalui LDAPS/StartTLS agar kredensial tidak terekspos.

questions.stem: Access to a resource is determined by the resource owner who sets permissions for individual users. Which access control model is this?
questions.explanation: **DAC** (Discretionary Access Control) memberi pemilik resource kebebasan menetapkan izin. **MAC** memakai label klasifikasi dan kebijakan sistem, **RBAC** berbasis peran, **ABAC** berbasis atribut.

questions.stem: A defense contractor requires that access be based on clearance level and object classification labels, and users cannot change permissions. Which model is this?
questions.explanation: **MAC** (Mandatory Access Control) memakai label keamanan dan kebijakan yang ditetapkan sistem (misalnya SELinux, Bell-LaPadula). Pengguna tidak dapat menurunkan klasifikasi atau membagikan akses.

questions.stem: A hospital grants nurses access based on their job function rather than individual permissions. Which model is this?
questions.explanation: **RBAC** memberikan izin melalui peran (nurse, doctor, billing) sehingga pengelolaan lebih sederhana dan konsisten. **ABAC** akan memakai atribut seperti departemen, waktu, dan lokasi.

questions.stem: An organization wants access decisions based on department, device compliance, time of day, and geolocation. Which model is MOST appropriate?
questions.explanation: **ABAC** mengevaluasi atribut subjek, objek, dan lingkungan sehingga sangat fleksibel untuk kebijakan kontekstual. Semakin banyak atribut, semakin kompleks pengujian kebijakannya.

questions.stem: A developer needs temporary admin access to production for two hours to troubleshoot an outage. Which practice is BEST?

options.text: Just-in-time elevation with approval and automatic revocation
Grant permanent admin rights to avoid future delays
Share the admin password with the team
Disable MFA for the admin account

questions.explanation: **JIT access** memberi hak istimewa sementara setelah persetujuan dan mencabutnya otomatis, mengurangi jendela penyalahgunaan. Hak permanen dan password bersama melanggar least privilege.

questions.stem: Which authentication method is considered phishing-resistant and passwordless?
questions.explanation: **FIDO2/passkey** memakai kriptografi kunci publik yang terikat pada origin, sehingga tidak dapat di-phish ke domain palsu. SMS OTP rentan SIM swapping dan real-time phishing.

questions.stem: A company wants to reduce the risk of credential stuffing against its web portal without changing the login experience for legitimate users. Which control is MOST appropriate?

options.text: Risk-based authentication with device fingerprint and impossible-travel checks

questions.explanation: **Risk-based/adaptive authentication** memicu langkah tambahan hanya saat risiko tinggi (perangkat baru, lokasi anomali). Rotasi password berkala justru mendorong password lemah dan tidak menghentikan credential stuffing.

questions.stem: Which account type should be used by an application to run scheduled tasks, with permissions limited to only the required resources?

options.text: Service account with least privilege and managed credentials

questions.explanation: **Service account** khusus aplikasi, dengan hak minimal dan kredensial terkelola (rotasi otomatis). Shared admin dan akun pribadi menghilangkan akuntabilitas.

questions.stem: A manager reviews a report listing all users with access to the finance share and confirms each still needs it. Which process is this?
questions.explanation: **Access review/attestation** memastikan hak akses masih sesuai kebutuhan dan kepatuhan. Temuan umum: hak berlebih (privilege creep) setelah mutasi jabatan.

questions.stem: An organization must store administrative passwords in a vault, rotate them automatically, and record who checked them out. Which solution is this?
questions.explanation: **PAM** (Privileged Access Management) menyimpan, memutar, dan mengaudit kredensial istimewa, serta sering menyediakan session recording untuk akun admin.

questions.stem: A company wants new employees to receive accounts and group memberships automatically based on their HR role, and to have them removed automatically on termination. Which approach is BEST?
questions.explanation: **Automated provisioning** (sering via **SCIM**) menyelaraskan akun dengan data HR, mengurangi akun yatim dan kesalahan manual. Proses tahunan terlalu lambat untuk risiko insider.

questions.stem: A cloud team wants to prevent developers from deploying storage buckets with public access, regardless of who runs the pipeline. Which control is BEST?

options.text: Guardrails/policy as code enforced in the pipeline

questions.explanation: **Guardrails** (misalnya OPA/SCP) menolak konfigurasi berbahaya secara otomatis dan konsisten. Review manual tidak dapat diskalakan dan mudah terlewat.

questions.stem: Which is a PRIMARY benefit of automating security operations with SOAR?

options.text: Removal of the need for human approval
Faster, consistent response and reduced analyst toil
Elimination of the need for logging

questions.explanation: Otomasi mempercepat respons, menstandarkan langkah, dan mengurangi pekerjaan berulang. Otomasi tidak menggantikan logging, tidak menjamin pencegahan total, dan tetap memerlukan persetujuan manusia untuk aksi berisiko.

questions.stem: An automation script that disables compromised accounts fails silently when the HR API changes, and no one notices for a week. Which risk of automation is demonstrated?

options.text: Single point of failure and lack of monitoring

questions.explanation: Otomasi menjadi **single point of failure** bila tidak dipantau; kegagalan harus memicu alert dan ada jalur manual (fallback). Ini juga contoh **technical debt** jika integrasi tidak dipelihara.

questions.stem: A CI/CD pipeline requires that secrets be fetched at runtime from a vault rather than stored in the repository. Which risk is being mitigated?
questions.explanation: Menyimpan secret di repo (termasuk history Git) membuatnya bocor ke siapa pun yang punya akses. Vault dengan akses berbasis identitas dan rotasi menghilangkan hard-coded credentials.

questions.stem: Which sequence correctly represents the incident response lifecycle?

options.text: Preparation → Detection and analysis → Containment → Eradication → Recovery → Lessons learned

questions.explanation: Urutan NIST: **Preparation, Detection & Analysis, Containment/Eradication/Recovery, Post-incident activity (lessons learned)**. Containment selalu sebelum eradication agar penyebaran berhenti lebih dulu.

questions.stem: A workstation is confirmed infected with malware that may still be running. Investigators need volatile evidence. Which action should be taken FIRST?

options.text: Isolate the host from the network but keep it powered on, then capture memory

questions.explanation: Mematikan host menghilangkan isi memori (proses, koneksi, kunci). **Isolasi jaringan** menghentikan penyebaran sambil mempertahankan bukti volatil; urutan volatilitas: memori → cache → disk → arsip.

questions.stem: After containing a ransomware outbreak, the team removes the malware, rebuilds encrypted servers, and restores data. Which phase follows next?

options.text: Recovery and validation, then lessons learned

questions.explanation: **Recovery** mengembalikan layanan secara terkontrol dan memvalidasi integritas, lalu **lessons learned** memperbarui prosedur dan kontrol. Preparation adalah fase sebelum insiden.

questions.stem: During an investigation, a laptop is seized and each transfer is logged with signatures, dates, and storage location. Which concept is this?
questions.explanation: **Chain of custody** mendokumentasikan siapa memegang bukti, kapan, dan di mana, sehingga bukti dapat diterima di pengadilan. Tanpa itu, integritas bukti dipertanyakan.

questions.stem: A legal department instructs IT to preserve all email and logs related to a lawsuit and to suspend automatic deletion. Which process is this?
questions.explanation: **Legal hold** menghentikan penghapusan data yang relevan dengan litigasi. Menghapus data setelah hold dapat dianggap obstruction of justice.

questions.stem: After an incident, the team asks "why did the phishing email bypass the gateway and why was the user not trained?" Which activity is this?
questions.explanation: **Root cause analysis** mencari penyebab mendasar (kontrol gagal, proses kurang) agar perbaikan tidak sekadar gejala. Hasilnya masuk ke lessons learned dan perbaikan kontrol.

questions.stem: A threat hunter forms a hypothesis that attackers are using signed binaries to evade detection, then searches telemetry for evidence. Which activity is this?
questions.explanation: **Threat hunting** berangkat dari hipotesis (bukan alert) dan mencari bukti di telemetri. Berbeda dari IR yang merespons insiden yang sudah terdeteksi.

questions.stem: An analyst must determine which internal host initiated a connection to a known malicious IP at 02:14. Which log source is MOST directly useful?

options.text: Firewall logs showing source IP, destination IP, and timestamp

questions.explanation: **Firewall logs** mencatat 5-tuple (source/dest IP, port, protokol) dan aksi, sehingga dapat mengidentifikasi host asal. DNS log membantu bila hanya domain yang diketahui.

questions.stem: Which tool is BEST for reconstructing an HTTP session and viewing the actual payload exchanged?
questions.explanation: **Packet capture/protocol analyzer** (Wireshark, tcpdump) menyimpan isi paket sehingga sesi dapat direkonstruksi. NetFlow hanya metadata, SIEM menampilkan log/alert.

questions.stem: An investigator needs a timeline of user logons, process execution, and file changes on a Windows host. Which source provides the MOST complete evidence?

options.text: EDR telemetry combined with Windows event logs

questions.explanation: **EDR telemetry** memberi process tree dan command line, sedangkan **event logs** memberi logon/audit. Menggabungkan keduanya menghasilkan timeline yang koheren.

questions.stem: Logs from servers are being overwritten after seven days, but an incident is discovered 30 days later. Which control should have been in place?
questions.explanation: **Log aggregation** mengirim log ke SIEM/arsip terpusat dengan retensi sesuai kebijakan, sehingga bukti tetap tersedia dan tahan terhadap penghapusan lokal oleh penyerang.

questions.stem: An analyst wants to compare the volume of outbound traffic per host over the last week to spot possible data exfiltration. Which data source is MOST appropriate?
questions.explanation: **NetFlow** menyimpan statistik byte/paket per aliran sehingga tren volume per host mudah dianalisis. Packet capture penuh terlalu besar untuk analisis jangka panjang.

questions.stem: A ransomware incident is contained, but the team must decide whether to pay the ransom. Which factor is MOST important to consider first?

options.text: Whether tested, isolated backups can restore the data within RTO
The attackers' reputation for returning data

questions.explanation: Pemulihan dari **backup teruji** adalah jalur utama; membayar tidak menjamin data kembali dan mendanai kejahatan. Keputusan harus melibatkan manajemen, hukum, dan asuransi.

questions.stem: A company wants to block outbound traffic to known malicious IPs at the network edge while allowing all other outbound traffic. Which control is MOST appropriate?

options.text: Egress filtering with threat intelligence blocklist

questions.explanation: **Egress filtering** mencegah host terinfeksi berkomunikasi dengan C2 dan mempersulit exfiltration. Ingress filtering melindungi dari koneksi masuk, tetapi tidak membatasi komunikasi keluar.

questions.stem: An organization wants to detect and block malicious PowerShell scripts that download and execute code. Which control combination is BEST?

options.text: Allowing only local administrators to use PowerShell
Script block logging, constrained language mode, and EDR behavior detection

questions.explanation: **Script block logging** merekam isi skrip, **constrained language mode** membatasi API, dan **EDR** mendeteksi perilaku mencurigakan. Membatasi ke admin saja tidak cukup karena akun admin juga bisa dicuri.

questions.stem: A penetration test finds that a low-privileged user can read the shadow file. Which category of finding is this?
questions.explanation: Akses ke file sensitif seperti `/etc/shadow` memungkinkan pengguna biasa menaikkan hak (misalnya crack hash lalu `su`). Ini eskalasi privilege lokal akibat permission yang salah.

questions.stem: Which wireless setting should be disabled because it allows attackers to brute-force the PIN and join the network?
questions.explanation: **WPS** PIN rentan brute force (Pixie Dust/offline attack) dan harus dimatikan. WPA3, 802.1X, dan PMF justru meningkatkan keamanan.

questions.stem: An organization discovers an unauthorized server running in a lab closet, connected to the corporate network. Which control gap does this expose?

options.text: Inadequate asset discovery and network access control

questions.explanation: Server tidak terinventarisasi adalah **shadow asset**; diperlukan **discovery** rutin dan **NAC/802.1X** agar perangkat tak terdaftar tidak dapat terhubung. Ini juga masalah change management.

questions.stem: Which MFA factor category does a hardware token that generates a time-based code belong to?
questions.explanation: Token fisik adalah faktor **possession** (something you have). Password = knowledge, biometrik = inherence, lokasi = location-based (bukan faktor utama dalam MFA klasik).

questions.stem: During an incident, the team blocks the attacker's IP at the firewall, disables the compromised account, and segments the affected VLAN. Which IR phase is this?
questions.explanation: **Containment** membatasi dampak dan menghentikan penyebaran. Eradication menghilangkan akar masalah (malware, backdoor), recovery mengembalikan layanan normal.

questions.stem: Which statement BEST describes the difference between a policy and a procedure?

options.text: A policy applies only to executives; a procedure applies only to IT
A policy is a high-level statement of management intent; a procedure is a detailed, step-by-step instruction
A policy is optional guidance; a procedure is a legal requirement
A policy describes technical settings; a procedure describes business goals

questions.explanation: **Policy** menyatakan maksud dan arah manajemen (apa dan mengapa), sedangkan **procedure** menjelaskan langkah operasional (bagaimana). **Standard** berisi persyaratan spesifik yang wajib, **guideline** bersifat rekomendasi.

questions.stem: Which document defines what employees may and may not do with company computing resources?
questions.explanation: **AUP** menetapkan penggunaan yang diizinkan dan larangan, termasuk konsekuensi pelanggaran. SLA mengatur tingkat layanan, BPA mengatur kemitraan bisnis.

questions.stem: An organization must define how long financial records and email are kept and how they are destroyed afterward. Which policy is required?
questions.explanation: **Data retention policy** menetapkan masa simpan berdasarkan kebutuhan bisnis dan regulasi, serta metode penghapusan. Ini juga mendukung e-discovery dan mengurangi risiko penyimpanan berlebih.

questions.stem: A security team documents who must approve firewall changes, what testing is required, and how to roll back. Which policy governs this?
questions.explanation: **Change management policy** menetapkan proses persetujuan, pengujian, jadwal, dan backout plan. Tujuannya mencegah perubahan tidak terkontrol yang mengganggu keamanan dan ketersediaan.

questions.stem: A company grants a temporary exception to allow an unsupported application for six months, with a documented risk owner and review date. Which governance element is this?
questions.explanation: **Exception** adalah penyimpangan resmi dan terdokumentasi dari kebijakan, dengan pemilik risiko, kontrol kompensasi, dan tanggal kedaluwarsa. Tanpa itu, penyimpangan menjadi pelanggaran tak terkelola.

questions.stem: Which group is typically responsible for approving security policies and accepting residual risk at the organizational level?
questions.explanation: **Security steering committee** (dewan tata kelola) menyetujui kebijakan dan menerima risiko residual. Administrator menjalankan kontrol, pen tester menguji, help desk menangani operasional.

questions.stem: Which is an example of a standard rather than a policy?

options.text: "The company is committed to protecting customer data"
"If a breach occurs, call the incident hotline"
"All laptops must use AES-256 full-disk encryption"

questions.explanation: **Standard** bersifat spesifik, terukur, dan wajib (AES-256). Pernyataan komitmen adalah policy, langkah operasional adalah procedure, dan saran adalah guideline.

questions.stem: After a merger, two companies have conflicting security requirements. Which approach BEST resolves the conflict?

options.text: Perform a gap analysis and update policies through the governance process
Let each department keep its own rules indefinitely
Apply the stricter rule only to the acquired company
Suspend all security controls until integration finishes

questions.explanation: **Gap analysis** memetakan perbedaan kontrol, lalu kebijakan diselaraskan melalui proses tata kelola dengan persetujuan manajemen. Membiarkan aturan ganda menciptakan celah dan kebingungan audit.

questions.stem: Which metric BEST indicates whether security awareness training is changing behavior?

options.text: Number of employees who completed onboarding
Phishing simulation click rate trending downward over time

questions.explanation: **Click rate** dan **reporting rate** pada simulasi phishing menunjukkan perilaku nyata, bukan sekadar kehadiran. Metrik input (jam pelatihan) tidak membuktikan efektivitas.

questions.stem: Which term describes the risk that remains after controls have been implemented?
questions.explanation: **Residual risk** adalah sisa risiko setelah kontrol diterapkan. **Inherent risk** adalah risiko sebelum kontrol; manajemen harus menyetujui residual risk yang tersisa.

questions.stem: An asset is valued at $200,000. A threat would destroy 25% of its value, and such an event is expected once every two years. What are the SLE and ALE?
questions.explanation: **SLE = Asset Value × Exposure Factor = $200,000 × 0.25 = $50,000**. **ALE = SLE × ARO = $50,000 × 0.5 = $25,000** (ARO 0,5 karena sekali per dua tahun).

questions.stem: A company buys cyber insurance to cover the financial impact of a breach. Which risk response is this?
questions.explanation: **Transfer** memindahkan dampak finansial ke pihak lain (asuransi, kontrak). Risiko operasional dan reputasi tetap ada, sehingga kontrol teknis tidak boleh dihapus.

questions.stem: A company stops offering a risky legacy service entirely rather than securing it. Which risk response is this?
questions.explanation: **Avoidance** menghilangkan aktivitas yang menimbulkan risiko. Ini berbeda dari mitigation yang mengurangi kemungkinan/dampak, dan acceptance yang menerima risiko.

questions.stem: Management decides that a low-impact risk is acceptable because the cost of the control exceeds the potential loss. Which concept is applied?

options.text: Risk acceptance based on cost-benefit analysis

questions.explanation: **Risk acceptance** dipilih ketika biaya kontrol lebih besar dari dampak yang diperkirakan, dan keputusan itu harus terdokumentasi. Ini bukan kelalaian selama ada analisis dan persetujuan.

questions.stem: Which document records identified risks, owners, likelihood, impact, and treatment status?
questions.explanation: **Risk register** adalah catatan hidup berisi risiko, pemilik, skor, dan rencana penanganan. Dokumen ini menjadi dasar pelaporan ke manajemen dan audit.

questions.stem: A risk assessment uses categories such as "low, medium, high" based on expert judgment rather than monetary values. Which type of analysis is this?
questions.explanation: **Qualitative** memakai skala subjektif (low/medium/high) dan cepat diterapkan. **Quantitative** memakai nilai moneter seperti SLE/ALE dan membutuhkan data lebih banyak.

questions.stem: Which statement BEST describes risk appetite?

options.text: The amount of risk an organization is willing to accept in pursuit of its objectives
The maximum downtime a system can tolerate
The list of risks identified during an assessment
The cost of implementing security controls

questions.explanation: **Risk appetite** adalah tingkat risiko yang bersedia diambil organisasi; **risk tolerance** adalah variasi yang dapat diterima di sekitar appetite tersebut. RTO berkaitan dengan ketersediaan, bukan selera risiko.

questions.stem: A KRI shows the number of unpatched critical vulnerabilities rising for three consecutive months. What is the PRIMARY purpose of this metric?

options.text: Replacing the need for vulnerability scans
Early warning that risk exposure is increasing, prompting action
Meeting the requirement to publish a security report

questions.explanation: **KRI** (Key Risk Indicator) memberi peringatan dini tentang memburuknya risiko sehingga tindakan dapat diambil sebelum menjadi insiden. Ini berbeda dari KPI yang mengukur kinerja.

questions.stem: Which risk assessment approach is MOST appropriate for a rapidly changing cloud environment?

options.text: Ad hoc assessment after an incident only

questions.explanation: Lingkungan yang berubah cepat membutuhkan **continuous risk assessment** agar risiko baru (konfigurasi berubah, aset baru) segera terdeteksi. Penilaian tahunan saja akan tertinggal.

questions.stem: A risk matrix plots likelihood against impact. A risk with high likelihood and high impact should be treated how?

options.text: Deferred to the next budget cycle
Prioritized for immediate mitigation or avoidance

questions.explanation: Risiko di kuadran likelihood tinggi/impact tinggi menjadi prioritas utama. Keputusan tetap harus melibatkan pemilik risiko, tetapi menunda tanpa alasan kuat tidak dapat diterima.

questions.stem: Before signing a contract with a new cloud vendor, a company sends a detailed security questionnaire and reviews the vendor's SOC 2 report. Which process is this?
questions.explanation: **Due diligence** menilai risiko vendor sebelum kontrak melalui kuesioner, sertifikasi, dan laporan audit. Hasilnya menentukan apakah kontrol tambahan atau klausul kontrak diperlukan.

questions.stem: Which contract clause allows a company to inspect a vendor's security controls and records?
questions.explanation: **Right-to-audit** memberi hak untuk mengaudit atau meminta bukti kepatuhan vendor. NDA mengatur kerahasiaan, SLA mengatur tingkat layanan, indemnification mengatur ganti rugi.

questions.stem: Which document is used to define a preliminary understanding between two parties before a formal contract, often non-binding?
questions.explanation: **MOU** (Memorandum of Understanding) menyatakan niat dan pemahaman bersama, umumnya tidak mengikat secara hukum. **MOA** lebih formal dan spesifik; **BPA** mengatur kemitraan bisnis; **SOW** merinci pekerjaan.

questions.stem: An organization relies on a single SaaS provider for a critical function, and migrating would require rewriting integrations. Which risk is this?
questions.explanation: **Vendor lock-in** membuat organisasi sulit berpindah penyedia, sehingga posisi negosiasi dan ketahanan melemah. Mitigasi: standar data terbuka, exit plan, dan multi-vendor untuk fungsi kritis.

questions.stem: A vendor subcontracts part of its service to another company without informing the customer. Which risk is MOST directly introduced?

options.text: Unassessed fourth-party risk in the supply chain

questions.explanation: **Subcontractor/fourth-party** memperluas rantai pasok tanpa penilaian, sehingga kontrol dan kepatuhan tidak diketahui. Kontrak harus mewajibkan persetujuan dan pengungkapan subkontraktor.

questions.stem: Which activity provides the MOST reliable evidence of a vendor's actual security posture over time?

options.text: Independent audit report covering a period (SOC 2 Type II)
A single phone interview with sales
Vendor's self-assessment completed in one day

questions.explanation: **SOC 2 Type II** menilai efektivitas kontrol selama periode tertentu oleh auditor independen. Self-assessment dan materi pemasaran tidak membuktikan operasi kontrol sehari-hari.

questions.stem: A company requires its cloud provider to notify it within 24 hours of any breach involving its data. Which document should contain this requirement?

options.text: Service level agreement or contract with security terms

questions.explanation: Kewajiban notifikasi insiden harus tertulis dalam **kontrak/SLA** (sering sebagai security addendum) agar dapat ditegakkan. AUP mengatur pengguna internal, bukan vendor.

questions.stem: A vendor's product is critical, but the vendor refuses any audit rights and provides no independent certifications. What is the MOST appropriate action?

options.text: Rely on the vendor's verbal assurance
Document the risk and require compensating controls or choose another vendor
Ignore the issue because the product is popular

questions.explanation: Risiko harus didokumentasikan dan diputuskan oleh pemilik risiko; kontrol kompensasi (segmentasi, monitoring, enkripsi) atau vendor alternatif dapat dipertimbangkan. Jaminan lisan bukan bukti.

questions.stem: Which agreement is specifically used when two organizations exchange data and defines how that data may be processed and protected?
questions.explanation: **DPA** mengatur pemrosesan data pribadi antara controller dan processor, termasuk tujuan, keamanan, dan subprocessor. NDA hanya mengatur kerahasiaan informasi.

questions.stem: Under GDPR, which party determines the purposes and means of processing personal data?
questions.explanation: **Controller** menentukan tujuan dan cara pemrosesan; **processor** memproses atas nama controller; **data subject** adalah individu yang datanya diproses. Kewajiban utama kepatuhan berada pada controller.

questions.stem: A US healthcare provider must protect patient records and ensure only authorized staff can access them. Which regulation applies?
questions.explanation: **HIPAA** mengatur perlindungan **PHI** (protected health information) di sektor kesehatan AS. PCI DSS untuk data kartu pembayaran, SOX untuk pelaporan keuangan, FERPA untuk data pendidikan.

questions.stem: A retailer accepts credit cards and must comply with requirements for storing and transmitting cardholder data. Which standard applies?
questions.explanation: **PCI DSS** menetapkan persyaratan untuk organisasi yang menangani data kartu pembayaran. ISO 27001 adalah standar sistem manajemen keamanan informasi, bukan khusus kartu.

questions.stem: A company wants to demonstrate to customers that its security controls are designed appropriately at a specific point in time. Which report is MOST appropriate?
questions.explanation: **SOC 2 Type I** menilai desain kontrol pada satu titik waktu; **Type II** menilai efektivitas operasi selama periode. Pen test menguji eksploitabilitas, bukan kepatuhan kontrol.

questions.stem: Which framework provides a voluntary, risk-based set of cybersecurity practices organized into functions such as Identify, Protect, Detect, Respond, and Recover?
questions.explanation: **NIST CSF** mengorganisasi praktik keamanan ke dalam fungsi Identify, Protect, Detect, Respond, Recover (dan Govern pada versi 2.0). Regulasi seperti HIPAA/PCI bersifat wajib untuk cakupan tertentu.

questions.stem: A customer asks for written confirmation that a vendor's controls meet agreed requirements. Which document satisfies this?
questions.explanation: **Attestation** adalah pernyataan resmi bahwa kontrol memenuhi persyaratan, sering didukung audit. Ini berbeda dari acknowledgment yang hanya menandakan penerimaan dokumen.

questions.stem: Which is a potential consequence of non-compliance with a regulatory framework?

options.text: Fines, sanctions, reputational damage, and loss of license

questions.explanation: Konsekuensi ketidakpatuhan mencakup **denda, sanksi, kerusakan reputasi, kehilangan lisensi, dan dampak kontrak**. Kepatuhan bukan jaminan keamanan, tetapi pelanggaran membawa risiko hukum dan bisnis.

questions.stem: A company processes EU residents' data and must respond to requests to access or delete personal data. Which concept is this?
questions.explanation: **Data subject rights** (akses, koreksi, penghapusan, portabilitas) mengharuskan organisasi memiliki proses untuk menemukan dan menghapus data pribadi. Ini memerlukan inventaris data yang baik.

questions.stem: Which statement BEST distinguishes an audit from an assessment?

options.text: An assessment results in certification; an audit does not
They are identical activities with different names
An audit provides independent, formal verification against criteria; an assessment is often an internal evaluation of controls or maturity
An audit is always performed by employees; an assessment by regulators

questions.explanation: **Audit** bersifat formal, independen, dan berbasis bukti terhadap kriteria (misalnya ISO 27001, SOC 2). **Assessment** bisa internal dan lebih fleksibel untuk mengukur maturity atau kesiapan.

questions.stem: An internal audit finds that 30% of servers are missing critical patches. What should happen NEXT?

options.text: Document the finding, assign an owner, and track remediation to closure
Delete the finding to protect the team
Wait for the external audit to confirm

questions.explanation: Temuan audit harus dicatat dengan bukti, ditindaklanjuti pemilik yang jelas, dan diverifikasi ulang. Menghapus temuan adalah pelanggaran integritas audit.

questions.stem: Before an external audit, a company reviews its own controls and evidence. Which activity is this?
questions.explanation: **Internal audit/readiness assessment** menemukan kekurangan sebelum auditor eksternal datang, memberi waktu perbaikan. Pen test menguji keamanan teknis, bukan kesiapan bukti kepatuhan.

questions.stem: A company runs monthly phishing simulations and tracks how many users report suspicious emails. Which metric BEST demonstrates program improvement?

options.text: Increased reporting rate and decreased click rate

questions.explanation: **Reporting rate naik** dan **click rate turun** menunjukkan pengguna semakin waspada dan mau melaporkan. Mengukur jumlah email terkirim tidak menunjukkan perubahan perilaku.

questions.stem: An attacker holds the door open for an employee carrying boxes and enters the building without a badge. Which social engineering technique is this?
questions.explanation: **Tailgating** (piggybacking) adalah mengikuti orang berwenang masuk tanpa otorisasi. Mitigasi: access control vestibule, pelatihan, dan kebijakan menantang orang tak dikenal.

questions.stem: Which training is MOST important for the finance department to prevent business email compromise?

options.text: Verifying payment changes through a separate known phone number
Learning to create strong passwords only

questions.explanation: BEC mengeksploitasi urgensi dan otoritas; kontrol kuncinya adalah **verifikasi out-of-band** sebelum mengubah data pembayaran. Password kuat tidak mencegah transfer yang salah.

questions.stem: A company wants to increase engagement in security training using points, badges, and leaderboards. Which technique is this?
questions.explanation: **Gamification** meningkatkan partisipasi melalui elemen permainan. Simulasi phishing melatih deteksi, role-based training menyesuaikan materi dengan pekerjaan.

questions.stem: An employee finds a suspicious email and forwards it to the security team instead of clicking. Which behavior is being reinforced?
questions.explanation: **Reporting culture** memungkinkan deteksi dini dan respons cepat. Program awareness harus mempermudah pelaporan (tombol report) dan memberi umpan balik positif, bukan menghukum kesalahan.

questions.stem: Which policy BEST reduces the risk of sensitive documents being photographed or removed from the office?

options.text: Clean desk and clear screen policy

questions.explanation: **Clean desk/clear screen** mencegah dokumen dan layar terbuka ditinggal tanpa pengawasan. Ini kontrol operasional sederhana yang sering diuji dalam audit fisik.

questions.stem: Which awareness topic is MOST relevant for employees who work remotely using personal Wi-Fi?

options.text: Risks of unsecured networks and the need for VPN/secure configuration

questions.explanation: Pekerja remote menghadapi risiko jaringan tidak tepercaya (evil twin, sniffing), sehingga perlu VPN, verifikasi jaringan, dan kebijakan perangkat. Topik fisik seperti rack server tidak relevan bagi mereka.

questions.stem: An insider threat program wants employees to recognize and report unusual behavior such as attempts to bypass controls. Which training element is MOST appropriate?
questions.explanation: **Scenario-based training** melatih karyawan mengenali tanda-tanda dan melapor melalui kanal yang jelas (termasuk anonim). Sekadar menandatangani kebijakan tidak mengubah kemampuan mendeteksi.

questions.stem: A phishing simulation has a very low click rate, but few users report the simulated emails. What should the program focus on NEXT?

options.text: Increasing the difficulty of simulations only
Ending the program because click rate is low
Punishing users who did not report
Encouraging reporting and simplifying the report process

questions.explanation: **Reporting rate** penting karena laporan pengguna mempercepat respons terhadap serangan nyata. Program harus mempermudah pelaporan dan memberi umpan balik, bukan menghukum.

questions.stem: Which document would a company use to define expected performance and availability of a service provided to a customer?
questions.explanation: **SLA** menetapkan tingkat layanan terukur (uptime, waktu respons, sanksi). MOU menyatakan niat, NDA kerahasiaan, AUP penggunaan yang dapat diterima.
